name: A Brutal Bladehead
description: A powerful looking blade, broken beyond repair. Still, perhaps you could learn something from it.

name: A Corroded Serrated Blade
description: The rusted remains of a symbol of authority. Perhaps you could learn something from it.

sources.notes: This vestige is found by the chest near the Heartstrings' starting tree.

name: A Cracked Bronze Vanity Mirror
description: Shows the worst possible side of yourself. Perhaps you could learn from it.

name: A Cruel Goblin Blade
description: A rusted blade with a wicked edge. Barely usable now, but perhaps you could learn something from it.

sources.notes: A cruel goblin blade is a vestige found on Goblins within Bramblemead Valley that unlocks the ability to create goblin "Swingslash".

name: A Mysterious Crescent Carving
description: What's left of a staff that feels soaked in sorrow. Perhaps you could learn something from it.

sources.notes: This is a rare drop from killing Garou druids; it may be recommended to go to Lougrim's Shrine at Stormtouched Highlands due to three druids spawning there.

name: A Simple Broken Bow
description: The remains of a longbow damaged in a dragon attack. Perhaps you could learn something from it.

name: A String of Sinew
description: Sinew, bound tightly enough to be dangerous. Useless now, but perhaps you could learn something from it.

sources.notes: They are received as a rare drop by Garou hunters.

name: A Threadbare Grain Sack
description: An odd bundle of scratchy sackcloth. It's unsettling to hold. Still, perhaps you could learn something from it.

name: Abraxus Ring
description: A ring that once belonged to a powerful necromancer.

sources.notes: Additional copies can be crafted from a jeweler's bench.

name: Abysmal Whip
description: It's... not quite finished.

sources.notes: The abysmal whip is a power level 4 one-handed melee weapon that can be created at a blacksmith's bench.

name: Abyssal Ashes
description: The sinister remnants of an abyssal creature.

sources.notes: Abyssal ashes are dropped from killing the abyssal demon.

name: Abyssal Remains
description: Perhaps you could learn from it[sic]

sources.notes: Abyssal Remains is a vestige dropped by an Abyssal Demon, required to create the Abysmal Whip.

name: Abyssal Spine
description: The spine from a deceased abyssal demon.

sources.notes: Abyssal spines are dropped from killing the abyssal demon and are a key material for players wishing to craft the abyssal whip.

name: Abyssal Whip
description: A brutal weapon crafted from the spine of a terrifying Abyssal Demon.

sources.notes: The abyssal whip is a power level 7 one-handed masterwork melee weapon that can be created at a blacksmith's bench.

name: Acrid Adhesive
description: A resilient adhesive that can withstand high temperatures.

name: Adamant Arrow
description: Arrows with tips forged from adamant.

sources.notes: Adamant arrows are a power level 7 ammunition that are crafted at a fletching bench, and can be used to craft adamant barbed arrow, poisoned adamant arrow, and adamant fire arrow.

name: Adamant Bar
description: A sturdy metal used for crafting weapons and armour.

sources.notes: Adamant bars are a processed material created with three adamantite ore and three coal inside a blast furnace.

name: Adamant Barbed Arrow
description: Lacerating arrows with barbed tips forged from adamant.

sources.notes: Adamant barbed arrows are a power level 7 ammunition that are crafted at a fletching bench.

name: Adamant Bolt
description: A crossbow bolt with an adamant tip.

sources.notes: Adamant bolts are a power level 7 ammunition crafted at a fletching bench.

name: Adamant Crossbow
description: A solid crossbow reinforced with adamant.

sources.notes: A adamant crossbow is a power level 7 crossbow crafted at a fletching bench.

name: Adamant Crossbow Limbs
description: A pair of adamant crossbow limbs. Used in crafting a adamant crossbow.

name: Adamant Dagger
description: Short, sharp and to the point.

name: Adamant Fire Arrow
description: Burning arrows with tips forged from adamant, coated in fire oil.

sources.notes: Adamant fire arrows are a power level 7 ammunition that are crafted at a fletching bench.

name: Adamant Greataxe
description: A big two-handed axe made of adamant.

name: Adamant Greatsword
description: A strong and massive blade made of adamant.

name: Adamant Helmet
description: A durable adamant helmet forged for the strongest of warriors.

name: Adamant Logging Axe
description: A strong woodcutting axe, good for trees that hit back.

name: Adamant Mace
description: An adamant mace designed to crush your enemies.

name: Adamant Med Helm
description: A sturdy adamant helm built for serious combat.

sources.notes: It can be crafted at an Armour Bench using 4 Adamant Bar, 4 Scorch Leather, 1 Desert Cloth, 1 Refined Obsidian, 1 Gypsum Wax, and 1 Garou Weave. The recipe for this item is obtained from purchasing the Deluxe Edition.

name: Adamant Pickaxe
description: A sturdy pickaxe made of adamant.

sources.notes: Adamant pickaxe is a power level 7 pickaxe that can be crafted at a blacksmith's bench. It can mine the same ores as the previous tiers, dealing 84 damage to minable ores, and 168 with a critical swing.

name: Adamant Platebody
description: A sturdy set of adamant chest armour, forged for the strongest of warriors.

name: Adamant Platelegs
description: A sturdy set of adamant leg armour, forged for the strongest of warriors.

name: Adamant Scimitar
description: A fast, curved, and very efficient sword.

name: Adamant Shield
description: Solid protection, slightly heavy.

name: Adamant Spade
description: A durable spade made from Adamantite.

sources.notes: It is crafted at the blacksmith's bench.

name: Adamant Sword
description: A reliable blade made of adamant.

name: Adamant Warhammer
description: A heavy warhammer forged from adamant.

name: Adamant Watering Can
description: The adamant watering can is a tool created at the blacksmith's bench.

sources.notes: The adamant watering can is a tool created at the blacksmith's bench.

name: Adamantite Ore
description: Mined from adamantite deposits. It can be smelted into bars at a Blast Furnace.

sources.notes: Adamantite ore is a basic Mining material mined from adamantite ore nodes, which can be found all over the Umbral Sands region. Three ores can be smelted along 3 pieces of coal in a blast furnace to produce adamant bars.

name: Adhesive
description: Glue friendly or else I'll take away the glue and then nobody will have any glue to glue with!

sources.notes: It is created by adding swamp tar to the kiln. thumb|How adhesive is created in the kiln

name: Advanced Tannery
description: Allows you to process tougher animal hides into leather.

name: Adventurer's Leggings
description: Basic and comfortable attire fit for a new adventurer.

sources.notes: Adventurer's leggings are a basic item that can be crafted using 6 coarse animal fur at the crafting table.

name: Adventurer's Longbow
description: The bane of deer everywhere.

sources.notes: The adventurer's longbow is a power level 2 longbow which can be crafted using a fletching bench. The recipe is learned by consuming the vestige: a simple broken bow, found in a chest inside of Finn's Cave.

name: Adventurer's Tunic
description: Basic and comfortable attire fit for a new adventurer.

sources.notes: Adventurer's tunic is a basic item that can be crafted using 9 coarse animal fur at the crafting table.

name: Advert-Inna-Bottle
description: An advert that details how to make an 'Ava's Accumulator'.

name: Aetheric Fundamentals, a Primordial Primer
description: A study on elemental forces and their interactions with runic energies.

sources.notes: Aetheric Fundamentals a Primordial Primer is one of five books in in the quest What Remains is Written that players must find to return to Abraxus The Eternal. This book is found at the top level of Silverthorn Keep behind the green dragon and to the right of the curse seal from Withering Heights.

name: Agility Cape
description: Congratulations! Reaching level 99 in Agility is an astonishing feat. Wear this cape with pride.

sources.notes: The Agility cape is a Cape of Accomplishment able to be crafted and worn with a level 99 Agility. It can be crafted at the crafting table.

name: Agility Flag
description: Your own Agility Flag.

name: Agility Orb
description: Your own Agility Orb.

name: Air Rune
description: Equippable as ammo when using a magic weapon.A symbol of blustering winds, essential for air-based magic and other spells. Runes are retained if you happen to die.

sources.notes: Air runes can be crafted at a rune altar at level 1 Runecrafting or higher, and can deal between 13-22 base damage, along with whatever staves the player equips.

name: Air Rune (Decoration)
description: Air rune is a constructed decoration that is unlocked once the player has received air rune in their inventory for the first time.

name: Amulet of Accuracy
description: The amulet of accuracy is an amulet that can be crafted at a jeweler's bench.

sources.notes: The amulet of accuracy is an amulet that can be crafted at a jeweler's bench.

name: Amulet of Defence
description: A mystical amulet that strengthens your defences.

sources.notes: The amulet of defence is an amulet that can be crafted at a jeweler's bench.

name: Amulet of Glory
description: The amulet of glory is an amulet that boosts melee, magic, and ranged critical damage while also increasing defence.

sources.notes: To unlock the recipe, players must find and study the commemorative coin vestige.

name: Amulet of Magic
description: The amulet of Magic is an amulet that can be crafted at a jeweler's bench.

sources.notes: The amulet of Magic is an amulet that can be crafted at a jeweler's bench.

name: Amulet of Strength
description: The amulet of strength is an amulet that can be crafted at a jeweler's bench.

sources.notes: The amulet of strength is an amulet that can be crafted at a jeweler's bench.

name: Amylase Crystal
description: A crystallised mass of amylase enzymes, can be used as a reagent potions.

sources.notes: Amylase crystal can be obtained by opening Agility course reward packs.

name: An Educational Blade
description: A crude wooden blade and handle, what's left of a child's toy turned to weaponry. Perhaps you could learn something from it.

sources.notes: This is found on the eastern side of the Temple of Saradomin roof.

name: An Ember-Edged Remnant of Cloth
description: Perhaps you could learn from it

name: Ancestral Hat
description: Woven with ancient knowledge and arcane tradition. The hat is old, the magic within is older.

sources.notes: Ancestral hat is a power level 8 magic armour piece that is crafted with an armour bench.

name: Ancestral Leggings
description: Enchanted garments that carry the legacy of generations of powerful spellcasters.

sources.notes: Ancestral leggings is a power level 8 magic armour piece that is crafted with an armour bench.

name: Ancestral Robe Legs
description: Ancestral Robe Legs are power level 8 magic armour that can be crafted at an armour bench

sources.notes: Ancestral Robe Legs are power level 8 magic armour that can be crafted at an armour bench.

name: Ancestral Robes
description: Robes worn in the pursuit of magical mastery, embroidered with symbols whose meaning has long been forgotten.

sources.notes: Ancestral robes is a power level 8 magic armour piece, crafted using materials found within the Scorned Wilderness raid zone.

name: Ancestral Staff
description: A staff carved from powerful magic wood, prized for its affinity with arcane energies.

sources.notes: it can be crafted at a Mystic Forge using 16 Magic Logs, 10 Harmonised Compound, 4 Vis Cloth, 4 Dragonstone, and 4 Draconic Vis Wax

name: Ancestral Wand
description: Forgotten magic lingers within this wand, waiting for a capable hand to awaken it.

sources.notes: It can be crafted at a mystic forge using 8 magic logs, 5 harmonised compound, 2 vis cloth, 2 dragonstone, and 2 draconic vis wax.

name: Anchovy Bait
description: Cute little cannibal fish love some anchovy bait. Irresistible to Herring. Increases the catch chance of this fish.

sources.notes: Anchovy bait is a power level 3 Fishing bait crafted at the crafting table.

name: Angler's Hat
description: A rather dapper looking cap that upon catching a fish has a chance to not reduce the amount of fish in the node.

sources.notes: Angler's hat is a power level 1 head armour which can be crafted using a crafting table. Wearing it provides a 10% chance to not deplete a fishing node when catching a fish. The recipe is learned by unlocking Experienced Angler at level 70 Fishing.

name: Anima-Infused Bark
description: Tree bark infused with magical energy.

sources.notes: Anima bark can be found on the ground around the anima trees and certain crystal trees located throughout the Fractured Plains biome. 300px|thumb|A anima tree with Anima-infused bark found on the ground around the tree.

name: Animal Bone
description: A sturdy bone from a sizable creature.

sources.notes: They can also be found on the ground in a cave in the Stormtouched Highlands.

name: Animal Hide
description: Gathered from big creatures, this hide is essential for crafting leather equipment.

sources.notes: Animal hide is a basic item gathered from animals like cows, deer, and wolves.

name: Animal Hide Scraps
description: Gathered from small creatures, too small to be processed into leather by itself.

sources.notes: Animal hide scraps are gathered from rats, kebbits, and chinchompas to create leather.

name: Animated Feather
description: To a fish, this feather looks like a long-lost love. Makes Armoured Catfish enamoured. Increases the catch chance of this fish.

sources.notes: Animated feathers are a power level 6 Fishing bait crafted at the crafting table.

name: Anti-Dragon Shield
description: This provides partial protection from dragonbreath attacks.

sources.notes: The anti-dragon shield is a power level 3 masterwork shield that can be crafted at a blacksmith's bench after obtaining the recipe from Vertentis Kara, the dragonkin vault in the Whispering Swamp.

name: Antifire Potion
description: PERK: AntifireNEGATES and grants RESISTANCE to FIRE effects

sources.notes: It is crafted with irit, blue dragon scale dust, and glass vessel.

name: Antipoison Potion
description: Removes poison and grants resistance to it. Made with irit and poison ichor.

sources.notes: It is crafted with irit, poison ichor, and glass vessel.

name: Antler
description: A cartilaginous extension of a deer skull.

sources.notes: Antlers are obtained by killing deer and are used in drinks, weapons, and armour.

name: Apprentice Hat
description: A comfortable hat made from linen, perfect for adventurers who are practicing magic.

sources.notes: Apprentice hat is a power level 2 magic armour that can be crafted at a crafting table.

name: Apprentice Leggings
description: Provides basic protection for trainees in the magical arts.

sources.notes: Apprentice leggings are a power level 2 magic armour that can be crafted at a crafting table.

name: Apprentice Robe
description: Provides basic protection for trainees in the magical arts.

sources.notes: Apprentice robe is a power level 2 magic armour that can be crafted at a crafting table.

name: Arcane Infusion
description: Puts the whiz in wizard.

name: Arcane Infusion (decoration)
description: A bottle of magical liquid to decorate your home with.

name: Arched Window Wall
description: A stylish castle wall.

name: Archery Target
description: Test your accuracy with your Ranged Weapons!

name: Armchair
description: A nice chair with good armrests.

name: Armour Bench
description: A dedicated station to craft all the armour you could possibly need.

sources.notes: The armour bench is unlocked upon obtaining a bronze bar.

name: Armour Mannequin
description: A mannequin on which you can mount armour on.

name: Arrowhead of Ancient Origin
description: Still sharp. Perhaps you could learn from it.

name: Artisan Cape
description: Congratulations! Reaching level 99 in Artisan is an astonishing feat. Wear this cape with pride.

sources.notes: The Artisan cape is a Cape of Accomplishment able to be crafted and worn at level 99 Artisan. It can be crafted at the mystic forge. Trimmed version of the cape can be crafted the same way if you have more than one skill at 99.

name: Ascension Core
description: Used to upgrade Masterwork Weapons and Vestiges from a lower Power level to Power Level 4.

sources.notes: Ascension cores are items used and crafted in the mystic forge to ascend masterwork weapons from their base power level to the next tier. The only core that cannot be crafted thus far is the power level 7 ascension core, which can only be acquired by completing the Nightmare Crucible.

name: Ascension Shard
description: Used to craft a Tier 4 Ascension Core

name: Ash Battlestaff
description: A magical weapon carved from ash wood.

sources.notes: It can be created at a crafting table using 12 ash logs, 6 rune essence, and 2 coarse thread.

name: Ash Chest
description: A small chest to store items in.

name: Ash Farming Plot
description: A plot made from Ash logs. Plants found in Brynmoor grow better in this plot.

sources.notes: The ash farming plot can be used to grow plants with seeds through the Farming skill.

name: Ash Logs
description: Pieces of wood collected from branches, saplings and Ash trees.

sources.notes: Ash logs are obtained by chopping down ash trees, picking them up off the ground, uprooting saplings, or chopping down thorny vines.

name: Ash Palisades
description: Simple wall used to create structures.

name: Ash Palisades Gate
description: Simple wall used to create structures.

name: Ash Pile
description: There seems to be something solid in the ash pile.

sources.notes: Ash pile are a drop from a lesser demon and contains cursed essence, vile ashes, and infernal fragments.

name: Ash Plank
description: Basic building material.

name: Ash Rod
description: A sturdy fishing rod, effective in Brynmoor.

sources.notes: The ash rod is a power level 2 Fishing tool crafted at the crafting table.

name: Ash Shortbow
description: A shortbow carved from ash wood.

sources.notes: Ash shortbow is a power level 2 Shortbow that can be crafted at a fletching bench.

name: Ash Tree Seed
description: Ash tree seeds. Plant this directly into the ground to grow your own Tree!

sources.notes: An ash tree seed is a type of seed, used with the Farming skill to grow an ash tree.

name: Ash Wand
description: A simple wand carved from ash wood. Every mage starts somewhere.

sources.notes: It can be crafted at a crafting table using 6 ash logs, 3 rune essence, and 1 coarse thread.

name: Astral Rune
description: Astral runes are used for casting advanced magic spells and attacks. Runes are retained if you happen to die.

sources.notes: Astral runes can be crafted at a rune altar at level 3 Runecrafting or higher. Astral runes are used in enchanting weapons, finding/gathering resources easily, accessing chests, and providing shelter.

name: Astral Rune (Decoration)
description: Astral rune is a decoration that is unlocked once the player has received an astral rune in their inventory for the first time.

name: Attack Cape
description: Congratulations! Reaching level 99 in Attack is an astonishing feat. Wear this cape with pride.

sources.notes: The Attack cape is a Cape of Accomplishment able to be crafted and worn at level 99 Attack. It can be crafted at the mystic forge. Trimmed version of the cape can be crafted the same way if you have more than one skill at 99.

name: Ava's Accumulator
description:
A bagged chicken ready to serve you, magnet in claw. 

Increases Arrow Recovery Chance and automatically picks up recovered arrows.

sources.notes: It is a reward from Animal Magnetism, and additional ones can also be crafted via the Armour Bench after the quest.

name: Avantoe
description: Can be used for potions.

sources.notes: Avantoe is an herb obtained by harvesting Avantoe plants. It can be farmed by planting avantoe seeds in a willow farming plot, with iron secateurs providing an increased yield when harvesting.

name: Avantoe Seeds
description: Equip and use these seeds to scatter them in a farming plot and start growing!Best planted in Fellhollow plots.

sources.notes: Avantoe seeds can be used to grow avantoe in a farming plot.

name: Azure Metal Contraption
description: A contraption made from strange blue metal. Perhaps you could learn something from it.

sources.notes: This is found in a chest, located under a cliff near the northern border of the Fractured Plains, west of the main river.

name: Bag of Flour
description: Cultivated grains ground to a fine powder.

name: Bag of Noggin'
description: The only thing this protects is your identity.

sources.notes: The bag of Noggin' is a piece of power level 1 head armour which can be crafted using a crafting table. The recipe is learned by consuming the vestige, a threadbare grain sack, found in a chest in Bramblemead Valley.

name: Baked Potato
description: Fluffy and delicious, if only you had some butter.

name: Ball of Wool Thread
description: A single ball of wool thread to decorate your home.

name: Bandosian Amulet
description: A goblin artefact, found on a druid.

sources.notes: It is one of two amulets, found in a reliquary in some Bramblemead ruins, while the other is found on a garou druid in the Whispering Swamp caves.

name: Barbed Appendage
description: Perhaps you could learn from it[sic]

name: Barrel Cactus Seed
description: A Barrel Cactus seed. Pop it into a farming plot and start growing!Best planted in Umbral Sand plots.

sources.notes: Barrel cactus seeds can be used to grow Barrel Cactus (Farming) in a farming plot.

name: Barrel Pile
description: A sturdy wooden barrel. A great decoration for your home.

sources.notes: The barrel pile does not need a foundation and can be built either indoors or outdoors.

name: Barrel of Granite
description: As decorations go, this couldn't be boulder!

name: Barrel of Sandstone
description: Chunks of sandstone stored in a barrel. Popular with masons.

name: Barrel of Stone
description: The tidiest way to store all those pretty pebbles you find.

name: Barricade
description: Vertical Thick Beam

name: Barricade End
description: Vertical Thick Beam

name: Battle-Scarred Black Metal
description: The remnants of a Zamorakian shield. Perhaps you could learn something from it.

sources.notes: It is obtained through Evil Emporium for 300 infernal fragments.

name: Beast-Training Notes
description: Notes, from the beastmasters of Dowdun Reach, on how to train various creatures.

name: Bed
description: A comfortable bed to sleep in and skip the night.

name: Bed Roll
description: A simple bedroll that you can sleep in and skip the night.

name: Bedraggled Spellbook
description: An ancient book of spells by Agatha's mail-order magic service. "Guaranteed to put warts on your nose, or your money back!"

sources.notes: The bedraggled spellbook is a quest item that is found during the Mirror, Mirror quest.

name: Beef & Tomato Stew
description: Hearty, healthy & delicious.

name: Beef & Tomato Stew (decoration)
description: Ah, what better way to decorate your home than steaming bowls of delicious stew?

name: Beltfish Broth
description: A potent soup made from beltfish.

name: Berry Compote
description: A fruity medley of cooked berries. A great, sweet treat for enjoying in the wild.

sources.notes: Berry compote is a consumable food item that can be crafted by combining redberries and dwellberries at a cooking pot.

name: Berry Drizzle Pan-Seared
description: Made by combining smoked herring, seared anchovies and dried dwellberry.

name: Bird Nest
description: I wonder what's inside...

sources.notes: Bird nests are drops found when felling trees. They contain assortments of skilling items that are dropped on the floor once opened. The ability to find bird nests is unlocked at 16 Woodcutting.

name: Bittercap Mushroom
description: A tasty mushroom. Can be used in a variety of cooking recipes.

sources.notes: They can be gathered from bittercap mushroom (plant)s in the Whispering Swamp and Dowdun Reach.

name: Black Adventurer's Cape
description: A simple, yet stylish accessory.

name: Black Crossbow Limbs
description: A pair of Black crossbow limbs. Used in crafting a Black Knight Crossbow.

sources.notes: They are created at a blacksmith's bench.

name: Black Desert Cape
description: A black cape, stitched in an ancient desert style. Its patterns reflect a long-standing mastery of life beneath the scorching sun.

sources.notes: The recipe is unlocked after studying the black memory of Menaphos vestige, which can be found in chests in Umbral Sands.

name: Black Dragon Hide
description: Obtained from felling black dragons. Can be processed at the tannery.

sources.notes: Black dragon hide is a basic material dropped by Black dragons which can be tanned to create Black Dragon Leather.

name: Black Dragon Leather
description: Made by tanning black dragonhide. A key component for ranged armour.

sources.notes: Black Dragon Leather is a processed material created with one black dragon hide, one dragon blood and one ground rune essence in the advanced tannery that can be used to craft power level 8 equipment.

name: Black Dragonhide Body
description: Tough, flexible black dragonhide armour trusted by hunters who prefer to strike from afar.

sources.notes: Black Dragonhide Body is a Power level 8 ranged armour piece crafted with an armour bench.

name: Black Dragonhide Chaps
description: Crafted from resilient black dragonhide, these leggings allow swift movement while providing excellent protection.

sources.notes: Black dragonhide chaps is a power level 8 ranged armour piece that is crafted with an armour bench.

name: Black Dragonhide Coif
description: Fashioned from black dragonhide, this helm offers protection without hindering an archer's awareness.

sources.notes: Black dragonhide coif is a power level 8 ranged armour piece that is crafted with an armour bench.

name: Black Greataxe
description: A hulking greataxe made from black metal.

sources.notes: The black greataxe is a power level 6 two-handed melee weapon that can be crafted at a blacksmith's bench.

name: Black Knight Helmet
description: A metal helm worn by the Black Knights of Dowdun Reach

sources.notes: Black Knight helmet is a power level 6 melee armour that can be created at a armour bench.

name: Black Knight Platebody
description: A heavy chestplate worn by the Black Knights of Dowdun Reach

sources.notes: Black Knight platebody is a power level 6 armour piece that can be created at a armour bench.

name: Black Knight Platelegs
description: Sturdy leg armour worn by the Black Knights of Dowdun Reach.

sources.notes: Black Knight platelegs is a power level 6 armour piece that can be created at a armour bench.

name: Black Knight's Fortress Reward Pack
description: A cloth shoulder bag[sic]

name: Black Memory of Menaphos
description: Perhaps you could learn something from it.

sources.notes: The black memory of Menaphos is a vestige that unlocks the black desert cape and can be found in chests throughout Umbral Sands.

name: Black Metal Bar
description: A bar of reforged black metal scraps. Used to make Black Knight gear.

name: Black Metal Scraps
description: Dropped from Black Knights. Can be reforged into black metal at a Blast Furnace.

sources.notes: Black metal scraps is dropped from Black Knights.

name: Black Salvage Pile
description: Scraps that can be searched through. Little bits of Black Knight are in there.

sources.notes: Black salvage piles are drops from defeating Black Knights.

name: Black Shield
description: A shield popularised by the Black Knights and made from black matal.

sources.notes: The black shield is a power level 6 shield that is crafted with a blacksmith's bench. Unlike the black weapons, the shield cannot be found in chests in Dowdun Reach. Given how long it takes to acquire black metal bars, this shield should only be crafted and/or ascended for the sake of fashion.

name: Black Sword
description: A sword in the style of the Black Knights, forged from black metal.

sources.notes: The recipe is unlocked after studying the shattered black blade vestige, which can be found in chests throughout Dowdun Reach or purchased from Postie Pete's Evil Emporium for 300 infernal fragments.

name: Blacksmith's Bench
description: A dedicated bench to craft all your tools and melee weapons.

sources.notes: The blacksmith's bench replaced the smithing anvil in the game, and is unlocked upon obtaining a bronze bar in the player's inventory.

name: Blast Furnace
description: The blast furnace uses intense heat to smelt high-tier metal ores into ingots.

sources.notes: This page is about the furnace capable of smelting higher tiered materials. It requires fuel pellets to operate, which can be obtained by combining charcoal, adhesive, and coarse animal fur at a blacksmith's bench. It can only be built once the player has unlocked the recipe after obtaining coal for the first time.

name: Blightwood
description: Logs cut from ancient trees or roots.

sources.notes: Blightwood can be found in Bloodblight Swamp. The wood can be chopped from the pale roots on larger trees in the swamp.

name: Blightwood Battlestaff
description: A magical weapon fit for a Wizard.

sources.notes: Blightwood battlestaff is a power level 4 two-handed staff that can be crafted with a mystic forge.

name: Blightwood Longbow
description: A finely crafted longbow, powerful and precise.

sources.notes:
thumb|Blightwood Longbow as seen when equipped by a player
Blightwood longbow is a power level 4 Longbows that can be crafted at the fletching bench, once the recipe is unlocked by cutting and picking up blightwood and swamp thread.

name: Blightwood Shortbow
description: A finely crafted bow, fast and reliable.

sources.notes: The blightwood shortbow is a power level 4 Shortbow that can be crafted at a fletching bench.

name: Blightwood Wand
description: Fashioned from blightwood, its magic feels unsettlingly eager to obey.

sources.notes: It can be crafted at a mystic forge using 6 blightwood, 3 wild anima, 2 swamp thread, and 2 vault shard.

name: Bloodblight Cape
description: A cloak commemorating a dragon's vengeance.

sources.notes: The recipe is unlocked by acquiring the Bloodblight Cape Pattern, found in a chest behind a broken wall in the Bloodblight Castle.

name: Bloodstained Black Visor
description: The remnants of a Zamorakian helmet. Perhaps you could learn something from it.

sources.notes: It is obtained through Evil Emporium for 200 infernal fragments.

name: Bloodstained Hilt
description: The remnants of a Zamorakian weapon. Perhaps you could learn something from it.

sources.notes: It is obtained through Evil Emporium for 300 infernal fragments.

name: Bloodwood Sap
description: Harvested from bloodwood trees found in the toxic swamp in Ghornfell.

sources.notes: Bloodwood sap can be found by logging the red formations on the bloodwood tree in the southernmost area of the Bloodblight Swamp, that is located in the middle of a garou camp. Players will need to use an iron logging axe or higher to harvest this material from the bloodwood tree.

name: Bludgeoning Obsidian Construct
description: Perhaps you could learn something from it.

sources.notes: It can be received as a drop by KotHaar-Ket in Umbral Sands.

name: Blue Adventurer's Cape
description: A simple, yet stylish accessory.

sources.notes: The recipe to craft the cape can be obtained by purchasing it from Death for soul fragments.

name: Blue Chandelier
description: A chandelier that can be hung from the ceiling.

sources.notes: A blue chandelier is a constructed object that can be built only indoors, and requires the player to place it under a horizontally flat foundation (e.g., square tile, square foundation, etc.)

name: Blue Desert Cape
description: A Blue cape, stitched in an ancient desert style. Its patterns reflect a long-standing mastery of life beneath the scorching sun.

sources.notes: The recipe is unlocked after studying the blue memory of Menaphos vestige, which can be found in chests in Umbral Sands.

name: Blue Dragon Leather
description: Made by tanning blue dragonhide. A key component for ranged armour.

sources.notes: Blue dragon leather is a processed material created from tanning blue dragon hide.

name: Blue Dragon Scale
description: Obtained from felled lesser blue dragons. Can be ground into blue dragon dust.

sources.notes: Blue dragon scale is dropped from blue dragon.

name: Blue Dragon Scale Dust
description: Ground from blue dragon scales. Integral to making antifire potions.

name: Blue Dragonhide
description: Obtained from felled Lesser Blue Dragons. Can be processed at the tannery.

sources.notes: Blue dragon hide is a basic material dropped by blue dragons which can be tanned to create blue dragonhide leather.

name: Blue Dragonhide Body
description: Ranged body armour crafted from blue dragonhide. Form-fitting, yet intimidating.

sources.notes: Blue dragonhide body is a power level 6 ranged armour that can be crafted at an armour bench. The recipe is unlocked upon obtaining blue dragon hide.

name: Blue Dragonhide Chaps
description: Flexible ranged leg armour crafted from blue dragonhide.

sources.notes: Blue dragonhide chaps is a power level 6 ranged armour that can be crafted at an armour bench. The recipe is unlocked upon obtaining blue dragon hide.

name: Blue Dragonhide Coif
description: Lightweight ranged headgear crafted from blue dragonhide.

sources.notes: Blue dragonhide coif is a power level 6 ranged armour that can be crafted at an armour bench. The recipe is unlocked upon obtaining blue dragon hide.

name: Blue Dyed Cape
description: A cape made for its looks more than any kind of magical potency.

sources.notes: The blue dyed cape is a stylish cape that can be created by learning the vestige bought from Postie Pete in Evil Emporium.

name: Blue Hex Cape
description: A cape made for its looks more than any kind of magical potency.

sources.notes: The blue hex cape is a stylish cape that can be created by learning the vestige bought from Postie Pete in Evil Emporium.

name: Blue Memory of Menaphos
description: Perhaps you could learn something from it.

sources.notes: The blue memory of Menaphos is a vestige that unlocks the blue desert cape and can be found in chests throughout Umbral Sands.

name: Blue Standing Torch
description: A torch that can be placed on surfaces.

sources.notes: Blue standing torch is a type of furniture that is created by learning the PLAN: blue standing torch recipe.

name: Blue Standing Torch (Dowdun Reach)
description: A torch that can be placed on surfaces.

name: Blue Torch
description: A trusty lightsource[sic] - now in blue.

name: Blue Wall-mounted Torch
description: A torch that can be mounted on vertical surfaces.

sources.notes: Blue wall-mounted torch is a type of furniture that is created by learning the PLAN: blue wall-mounted torch recipe.

name: Blue Wall-mounted Torch (Dowdun Reach)
description: A torch that can be placed on surfaces.

name: Blurite Bar
description: A rare bar of refined blurite, thought to be a myth.

sources.notes: A blurite bar can be made in a furnace by smelting three blurite ore.

name: Blurite Bar (decoration)
description: An blurite bar to place around your home.

sources.notes: The blurite bar decoration does not need a foundation and can be built either indoors or outdoors.

name: Blurite Bolts
description: Crossbow Bolts made from Blurite.

sources.notes: They are crafted at a fletching bench after unlocking the recipe with the vestige: azure metal contraption.

name: Blurite Crossbow
description: A crossbow made from Blurite, thought to be a myth.

sources.notes: The blurite crossbow is a power level 4 crossbow that can be crafted at a fletching bench. The recipe is learned after studying the azure metal contraption found in a chest in northwest Fractured Plains.

name: Blurite Crossbow Limbs
description: A pair of blurite crossbow limbs. Used in crafting a Blurite Crossbow.

sources.notes: They are crafted at a blacksmith's bench after unlocking the recipe with the vestige: azure metal contraption.

name: Blurite Ore
description: A chunk of rare and unrefined blurite.

sources.notes: Blurite ore is a basic Mining material found by mining the blurite ore nodes in the Takla Kara vault. Players can smelt this ore in a furnace to make blurite bars.

name: Bolt of Coarse Thread
description: A single bolt of thread to decorate your home.

name: Bone Bolts
description: Lightweight, but very sharp. Can be fired using the Dorgeshuun Crossbow.

name: Bone Club
description: A primitive weapon made from bone, perfect for smashing other bones.

sources.notes: The bone club is a power level 2 one-handed melee weapon that can be crafted at a crafting table.

name: Bone Crossbow Limbs
description: Crossbow limbs made from powerful bone. Used in crafting the Dorgeshuun Crossbow.

sources.notes: Bone crossbow limbs can be created at a blacksmith's bench and can be used to craft a Dorgeshuun crossbow.

name: Bone Dagger
description: A sinister weapon, crafted from the bones of fallen creatures.

sources.notes: The bone dagger is a power level 2 one-handed melee weapon that can be crafted at a crafting table.

name: Bone Pickaxe
description: A basic mining tool made from tough animal bone. It is hard enough to mine copper and tin deposits.

sources.notes: A bone pickaxe is a power level 2 pickaxe that can be crafted at a crafting table. It can mine the same ores as the previous tiers, along with copper ore, and tin ore, dealing 15 damage to minable ores, and 30 damage with a critical swing.

name: Bookcase
description: A place to store all your most beloved stories.

name: Bow of Elidinis
description: This ancient bow is a relic of Elidnis: Goddess of the Moon, Rivers, Growth and Fertility.

sources.notes: The bow of Elidinis is a power level 7 masterwork longbow that can be crafted at a fletching bench. Kills with water magic have a chance to drop water orbs that provide some health and a little hydration when picked up.

name: Bowl of Onions
description: A decoration that brings a tear to your eyes.

name: Bowl of Peaches
description: A bowl of delicious, juicy fruit. Just don't think about how you got them.

name: Braised Catfish
description: If your feline hungry, eat a catfish. Grants the Sea Life perk.[sic]

name: Braised Undead Eel
description: Makes you queasy but does wonders for hunger. Grants the Warding Fish perk.[sic]

sources.notes: It is made by cooking raw undead eel on either a campfire or a grill, and is used in fish fry.

name: Bramblemead Cape
description: A cloak to remember simpler times.

sources.notes: The recipe is unlocked by acquiring the Bramblemead Cape Pattern, found in a chest atop the Runecrafting Guild. Using only Windstep to reach the chest is considerably difficult; it is recommended to do this in combination with building foundations.

name: Bread
description: Crusty brown outside, pillowy white inside.

sources.notes: It can be created by using a bag of flour on a kiln.

name: Brewing Cauldron
description: This cauldron is built to brew liquids. Potions can be created here.

sources.notes: It does not have any shelter restrictions and can be placed without a foundation.

name: Broken Titan's Wrath
description: The shattered remnant of the Black Knight Titan's sword.

sources.notes: The broken Titan's Wrath is a quest item dropped by the Black Knight Titan. Subsequent drops of this item will be placed in the quest item tab of the inventory automatically.

name: Broken Wooden Crate
description: Sometimes what a home needs is random detritus as decoration. That's my excuse anyway.

sources.notes: The broken wooden crate does not need a foundation and can be placed either indoors or outdoors.

name: Bronze Arrow
description: Arrows with tips forged from bronze.

sources.notes: Bronze arrows are power level 3 ammunition that can be crafted at a fletching bench.

name: Bronze Bar
description: A versatile crafting material, smelted from bars of copper and tin.

sources.notes: It is created by smelting 3 copper ore and 3 tin ore at a furnace.

name: Bronze Bar (decoration)
description: A bronze bar to place around your home.

sources.notes: The bronze bar decoration does not need a foundation and can be built either indoors or outdoors.

name: Bronze Barbed Arrow
description: Lacerating arrows with barbed tips forged from bronze.

sources.notes: Bronze barbed arrows are bronze arrows with weapon barbs crafted on the arrow.

name: Bronze Bolts
description: Crossbow bolts made from bronze.

name: Bronze Crossbow
description: A 1-Handed Crossbow made from Bronze.

sources.notes: A bronze crossbow is a power level 3 Crossbow that can be crafted at a fletching bench.

name: Bronze Crossbow Limbs
description: A pair of bronze crossbow limbs. Used in crafting a Bronze Crossbow.

sources.notes: They are crafted at a blacksmith's bench.

name: Bronze Dagger
description: A small blade forged from bronze, suitable for close combat.

sources.notes: The bronze dagger is a power level 3 one-handed melee weapon that can be crafted at a blacksmith's bench.

name: Bronze Fire Arrow
description: Burning arrows with tips forged from bronze coated in fire oil.

name: Bronze Greatsword
description: A two-handed bronze sword for those who prefer power over speed.

sources.notes: The bronze greatsword is a power level 3 two-handed melee weapon that can be crafted at the blacksmith's bench.

name: Bronze Helmet
description: A helmet forged from bronze.

sources.notes: A bronze helmet is a power level 3 armour piece that can be crafted at a armour bench.

name: Bronze Leaf
description: A thin sheet of purest bronze, can be used for demonstrating your prowess, potion making or even recycling into bronze bars.

sources.notes: To obtain these, players must either collect them from bronze (or better) reward packs or recycle bronze bars in the jeweler's bench to make sheets of ten per bar.

name: Bronze Logging Axe
description: A woodcutter's tool, forged from bronze.

sources.notes: The bronze logging axe is a power level 3 logging axe that can be crafted at a blacksmith's bench. Deals 20 damage when felling applicable trees, and 30 when overhead chopping to split them.

name: Bronze Mace
description: Crush your foes with this heavy, spiked bronze mace.

sources.notes: The bronze mace is a power level 3 one-handed melee weapon that can be crafted at a blacksmith's bench.

name: Bronze Med Helm
description: A simple bronze helm that's seen more training grounds than battlefields.

sources.notes: It can be crafted at an Armour Bench using 4 Bronze Bar, 2 Hard Leather, and 1 Wool Thread. The recipe for this item is obtained from purchasing the Deluxe Edition.

name: Bronze Medal
description: thumb|The icon for the Bronze Medal in the building menu.

name: Bronze Pickaxe
description: A trusty tool for mining, made from sturdy bronze.

sources.notes: The bronze pickaxe is a power level 3 pickaxe that can be crafted at a blacksmith's bench. It can mine the same ores as the previous tiers, along with iron ore, as well as sandstone, and granite, dealing 34 damage to mineable ores, and 68 with a critical swing.

name: Bronze Platebody
description: A heavy chestplate made from bronze.

sources.notes: A bronze platebody is a power level 3 armour piece that can be crafted at a armour bench.

name: Bronze Platelegs
description: Heavy platelegs made from bronze.

sources.notes: Bronze platelegs Is a power level 3 armour piece that can be crafted at a armour bench.

name: Bronze Salvage Pile
description: Scraps that can be searched through. Seems like it's just a pile of bronze offcuts.

sources.notes: Bronze salvage piles are a basic material, nine of them can be smelted in a furnace to create one bronze bar.

name: Bronze Shield
description: Steadily block and parry attacks with this basic, dependable bronze shield.

sources.notes: The bronze shield  is a power level 3 shield that can be crafted at a blacksmith's bench.

name: Bronze Spade
description: A basic Spade made from bronze.Used to clear farming plots.

sources.notes: A bronze spade is a power level 2 spade that can be crafted at a blacksmith's bench.

name: Bronze Sword
description: A well-balanced bronze blade.

sources.notes: The bronze sword is a power level 3 one-handed melee weapon that can be crafted at a blacksmith's bench.

name: Bronze Warhammer
description: A heavy-hitting, two-handed weapon crafted from bronze.

sources.notes: The bronze warhammer is a power level 3 two-handed melee weapon that is crafted at the blacksmith's bench.

name: Bronze Watering Can
description: The bronze watering can is a tool created at the blacksmith's bench.

sources.notes: The bronze watering can is a tool created at the blacksmith's bench.

name: Bucket of Milk
description: A bucket of milk from a stubborn cow.

sources.notes: To obtain it, players must interact with the cow just outside of the quest starting area, in a pen.

name: Build Protection Totem
description: Prevents other players from building anything within its sphere of influence.

name: Bundle of Undead Twigs
description: Manktongue needs these undead twigs to make Ava's accumulator

sources.notes: A bundle of undead twigs is a quest item obtained during the quest Animal Magnetism.

name: Bunny Cactus Seed
description: A Bunny Cactus seed. Pop it into a farming plot and start growing!Best planted in Umbral Sand plots.

sources.notes: Bunny cactus seeds can be used to grow Bunny Cactus (Farming) in a farming plot.

name: Burnished Belt Buckle
description: The ancient remnants of some sort of armour. Perhaps you could learn something from it.

description: Too well done, but still edible.

description: Too well done, but still edible.

description: A little too well done.

description: A little too well done.

sources.notes: Players can also receive burnt fillets as a drop from chopping down dead trees.
