description: Too well done, but still edible.

name: Burnt Watermelon
description: Too well done, but still edible.

name: Cabbage
description: Yuck I don't like cabbage.

sources.notes: They can be gathered from cabbage plants in Bramblemead Valley and cabbage (Farming) from cabbage seeds.

name: Cabbage Seeds
description: Cabbage Seeds. Equip and use them to scatter these into a farming plot and start growing! Best Planted in Brynmoor plots.

sources.notes: Cabbage seeds can be used to grow Cabbage in a farming plot.

name: Cactus Fibres
description: Pipe cactus, sans water.

sources.notes: Cactus fibres is a material item created at a tannery, and is a requirement to make desert cloth.

name: Cactus Steak
description: A moist and sweet botanical edible. It has a fresh floral fragrance.

name: Cactus Water
description: A brackish but refreshing beverage.

name: Cadavaberries
description: Can be eaten raw, but wouldn't recommend it. Can be cooked alone or as an ingredient in cooking meals.

sources.notes: They can be collected from cadavaberry bushes in Fellhollow and Farmed from cadavaberry bush (Farming) grown from cadavaberry seeds.

name: Cadavaberry Infusion
description: A refreshing fruity drink. Excellent for hydration.

name: Cadavaberry Seeds
description: A handful of Cadavaberry Seeds. Equip and use them to scatter these into a farming plot and start growing! Best planted in Fellhollow plots.

sources.notes: Cadavaberry seeds can be obtained from harvesting wild cadavaberry bushes.

name: Campfire
description: A nice hot fire on which to cook food or purify dirty water.

name: Cape Hook
description: A hook that elegantly displays a cape.

name: Cape Rack
description: A rack that elegantly displays a cape.

name: Carved Bone Animal Lure
description: Seems eager to be elsewhere. Perhaps you could learn from it.

name: Cauterised Undead Steak
description: A technically edible steak. Morally? That's another question[sic]

name: Chair
description: A simple chair.

name: Challenge Horn
description: An ornate dragonkin horn, traditionally used to challenge someone to a duel of honour. Bring it to the dragonkin altar to challenge Velgar.

sources.notes: It can be created at a blacksmith's bench.

name: Chandelier
description: A chandelier that can be hung from the ceiling.

sources.notes: A chandelier is a constructed object that can be built only indoors, and requires the player to place it under a horizontally flat foundation (e.g., square tile, square foundation, etc.)

name: Charcoal
description: Produced by burning wood in a kiln. Charcoal is a very efficient fuel.

sources.notes: Charcoal is a form of fuel created by processing wood at a kiln.

name: Cheeky Fryup
description: A surefire hangover cure.

name: Cheeky Fryup (decoration)
description: Enjoy this classic breakfast meal as a decoration for your home.

name: Chef's Hat
description: What a silly hat.

sources.notes: The chef's hat is a power level 1 headwear whose recipe is obtained when a player reaches level 40 Cooking and obtains the perk Yes, chef!.

name: Chewed Blue Cloth
description: Some dodgy-looking scraps of what seems to be a cape. Perhaps you could lear from it.

sources.notes: It is obtained through Evil Emporium for 150 infernal fragments.

name: Chewed Green Cloth
description: Some dodgy-looking scraps of what seems to be a cape. Perhaps you could lear from it.

sources.notes: It is obtained through Evil Emporium for 150 infernal fragments.

name: Chewed Pink Cloth
description: Some dodgy-looking scraps of what seems to be a cape. Perhaps you could learn from it.

sources.notes: It is obtained through Evil Emporium for 150 infernal fragments.

name: Chewed Red Cloth
description: Some dodgy-looking scraps of what seems to be a cape. Perhaps you could lear from it.

sources.notes: It is obtained through Evil Emporium for 150 infernal fragments.

name: Chewed Yellow Cloth
description: Some dodgy-looking scraps of what seems to be a cape. Perhaps you could lear from it.

sources.notes: It is obtained through Evil Emporium for 150 infernal fragments.

name: Chieftain's Blade
description: The sword of a goblin chieftain, used to spread war in the name of the Big High War God.

sources.notes: The chieftain's blade is a power level 3 one-handed weapon, created by combining 10 bronze bars, 2 antlers, and 2 animal bones at a blacksmith's bench. The recipe is learned by consuming the vestige a corroded serrated blade, found in a chest atop the same plateau where you start the Heartstrings quest.

name: Chipped Obsidian Construct
description: Perhaps you could learn from it[sic]

name: Chitinous Carapace
description: Perhaps you could learn from it[sic]

name: Clay
description: Essential for pottery and construction, dig it up from nearby water sources.

sources.notes: Clay is a basic Mining material that can be mined from clay nodes.

name: Clay Decoration
description: A figurine made of clay. Now hardened.

sources.notes: A clay decoration is an item that can be crafted by using three pieces of clay on a pottery wheel to produce a clay decoration (unfired), and then using the unfired clay decoration on a kiln to create the finished clay decoration.

name: Clay Decoration (Unfired)
description: A figurine made of clay. Still wet.

name: Clay Mould
description: A blank canvas for creating enchanted amulets; just add precious metals and gems.

name: Clay Mould (Unfired)
description: Bake this in a kiln to create an amulet mould.

sources.notes: An unfired clay mould is a resource that is created by combining three clay on a pottery wheel.

name: Clay Slab
description: Unknown ([https://dragonwilds.runescape.wiki/w/Clay_Slab?action=edit edit])

sources.notes: A clay slab is an item that is not currently found in the game.

name: Clay Slab (Unfired)
description: Unknown ([https://dragonwilds.runescape.wiki/w/Clay_Slab_(Unfired)?action=edit edit])

name: Clay Vessel
description: This bowl is empty.

sources.notes: Clay vessels can be created with clay vessel (unfired) at a kiln, and can be used at a brewing cauldron to hold potions.

name: Clay Vessel (Unfired)
description: A formed clay bowl, ready to be fired in a kiln.

sources.notes: A clay vessel (unfired) can be created with clay at a pottery wheel.

name: Clean Water
description: A source of hydration, free from the taint of natural water sources.

name: Cloying Damp Cowl
description: The ancient remnants of some sort of armour. Perhaps you could learn something from it.

name: Coal
description: Typically found in rocky areas and caves. Combine with metal ores at an upgraded smelter to create higher tiered metal bars.

sources.notes: Coal is a basic Mining material mined from coal nodes, which can be found all over the Fellhollow, Dowdun Reach and Umbral Sands regions. It is used as a secondary ingredient for ores smelted in a blast furnace.

name: Coarse Animal Fur
description: It's not much, but it'll keep you warm. Required to craft a basic bed.

sources.notes: Coarse animal fur is a basic item gathered from killing kebbits and rats.

name: Coarse Net
description: Made with two coarse threads at a crafting table. Rough but effective.

sources.notes: The coarse net is a power level 2 Fishing tool crafted at the crafting table. It is used to catch shrimp from net fishing spots found in Brynmoor.

name: Coarse Thread
description: Spun from flax at a Spinning Wheel.

sources.notes: Coarse thread is a material item created at a spinning wheel. It can be crafted using either 1 flax or 3 coarse animal fur, either of which will create a single coarse thread.

name: Coarse Thread Bin
description: All the coarse thread you could eat, in a tidy little bin.

name: Coarse Thread Pile
description: A mound of thread, just waiting for a needle.

name: Coclear Malificarum
description: A sealed scroll full of forbidden magics.

sources.notes: Coclear Malificarum is a quest item obtained on the ground by Ulgo the zogre.

name: Commemorative Coin
description: Perhaps you could learn something from it.

sources.notes: It can be received as a drop by red dragon in Umbral Sands.

name: Community Cape
description: A symbol of dedication and support, this cape is granted to those who leave a lasting mark on the community.

sources.notes: The community cape is a basic item having no special requirements, and can be created at a crafting table.

name: Compost Bin
description: Deposit all of your unwanted food or plant matter to turn it into compost over time.

name: Compost Bucket
description: Contents: Compost: [X]/150 A wooden bucket used to carry a variety of compost. Pour its contents out over a Farming Plot to fertilize your plants!

sources.notes: The compost bucket is a tool created at the crafting table.

name: Construction Cape
description: Congratulations! Reaching level 99 in Construction is an astonishing feat. Wear this cape with pride.

sources.notes: The Construction cape is a Cape of Accomplishment able to be crafted and worn at level 99 Construction. It can be crafted at the mystic forge. Trimmed version of the cape can be crafted the same way if you have more than one skill at 99.

name: Cooking Cape
description: Congratulations! Reaching level 99 in Cooking is an astonishing feat. Wear this cape with pride.

sources.notes: The Cooking cape is a Cape of Accomplishment able to be crafted and worn at level 99 Cooking. It can be crafted at the mystic forge. Trimmed version of the cape can be crafted the same way if you have more than one skill at 99.

name: Cooking Pot
description: A sturdy pot over a campfire that can be used to combine ingredients to make better meals.

name: Cooking Range
description: A workstation dedicated to cooking food. A cooking range can be used to cook hearty meals as well as individual raw foods.

sources.notes: NOTE: To learn the recipe (see it in the build menu), you MUST interact with the basic campfire at a certain cooking level, on top of having obtained all the materials required to build it.

name: Cooling Arcane Infusion
description: Puts the whiz in wizard.

name: Cooling Evasive Infusion
description: A thirst-quenching drink that improves your reflexes.

name: Cooling Ferocious Infusion
description: A hydrating drink infused with primal fury.

name: Cooling Fleet-Footed Infusion
description: A thirst-quenching drink that puts a spring in your step.

name: Cooling Relentless Infusion
description: A tasty tipple that'll put a quiver in your quiver.

name: Copper Ore
description: Mined from copper deposits. It can be smelted at a Furnace.

sources.notes: Copper ore is a basic Mining material mined from copper ore nodes, which are mainly found in the Fractured Plains. It can be smelted at a furnace along with Tin to produce bronze bars.

name: Corpse Cotton
description: Drops from a volatile bulbous plant that explodes when hit. Can be spun at the spinning wheel to create fine thread.

sources.notes: Corpse cotton is a drop from zogres and corpse cotton plants which is used to create fine thread.

name: Corpse Cotton Seeds
description: Corpse Cotton seeds. Equip and use them to scatter these into a farming plot and start growing! Best Planted in Fellhollow plots.

sources.notes: They can be used to grow Fellhollow's corpse cotton plants in a farming plot. Corpse cotton seeds can be obtained from harvesting wild corpse cotton plants.

name: Corroded Curved Blade
description: Perhaps you could learn from it

sources.notes: This vestige can be found in a chest after the Kalphite Queen boss fight in the south-western vault found within Umbral Sands.

name: Corroded Jewellery
description: A sinister piece of jewellery, corroded and burned. Perhaps you can learn something from it.

name: Corroded White Visor
description: A battered helmet. Perhaps you could learn something from it.

name: Corrupted Essence Sample
description: A strange sickly essence, linked to the corruption in Dowdun Reach. It writhes as you look at it.

sources.notes: A corrupted essence sample is a quest item dropped by corrupted ravens.

name: Crafting Table
description: A simple crafting station equipped with an array of primitive tools. It is used to craft equipment and other important resources.

sources.notes: It does not have any indoor/outdoor restrictions and can be placed without a foundation.

name: Crate
description: A simple crate.

sources.notes: A crate is a tier 1 constructed object that does not have restrictions to build indoors/outdoors and does not require a foundation to build.

name: Cross Slit Wall
description: A stylish castle wall.

name: Crucible Engram of Betrayal
description: A key to a specific Nightmare Crucible.

name: Crucible Engram of Helplessness
description: A key to a specific Nightmare Crucible.

name: Crucible Engram of Humiliation
description: A key to a specific Nightmare Crucible.

name: Crucible Engram of the Hounded
description: A key to a specific Nightmare Crucible.

name: Crushed Obsidian Construct
description: Perhaps you could learn from it[sic]

name: Crushed White Cuisse
description: The ancient remnants of some sort of armour. Perhaps you could learn something from it.

name: Crystal Bow
description: A powerful Shortbow fashioned from crystal of elven origin.

sources.notes: The crystal bow is a power level 3 masterwork shortbow that can be obtained (as well as its crafting recipe) as a reward from the Heartstrings quest. It can then be crafted at a fletching bench.

name: Crystal Seed
description: A resonating crystal, waiting for the right song.

sources.notes: A crystal seed is a quest item found upon searching the first memorial stone in the quest, Heartstrings.

name: Curse Carrying Crown
description: The ancient remnants of some sort of armour. Perhaps you could learn something from it.

name: Curse Fragment (Despair)
description: A crystallised part of a curse, imbued with Imaru's despair.

sources.notes: This can be found at the top of the Silverthorn Keep region of Fellhollow, and is guarded by a green dragon.

name: Curse Fragment (Grief)
description: A crystallised part of a curse, imbued with Imaru's grief.

sources.notes: It can be found within the Emberwood village in Fellhollow after dispelling the barrier surrounding the village.

name: Curse Fragment (Rage)
description: A crystallised part of a curse, imbued with Imaru's rage.

sources.notes: It can be found within the Vekchenven Kara vault which is behind a waterfall within the Lake of Lost Souls region of Fellhollow. The curse fragment is at the end of the vault and can be obtained after defeating the zogre.

name: Cursed Essence
description: Harvested from demons. Can be used as a tanning agent at the tannery.

name: Cursed Leather
description: A sinister leather. Used in crafting.

name: Curved Inner Corner 45° Stairs
description: Stairs used to round corners.

name: Curved Outer Corner 45° Stairs
description: Stairs used to round corners.

name: Dark Mage Hood
description: A mystical hood, popular with edgier wizards.

sources.notes: Dark mage hood is a power level 4 magic armour that can be created at an armour bench. The recipe is discovered after obtaining padded cloth.

name: Dark Mage Robe Legs
description: Lightweight magical armour for edgier spellcasters.

sources.notes: Dark mage robe legs is a power level 4 magic armour that can be created at an armour bench. The recipe is discovered after obtaining padded cloth.

name: Dark Mage Robes
description: Magical armour for the edgier wizard.

sources.notes: Dark mage robes are a power level 4 magic armour that can be created at an armour bench. The recipe is discovered after obtaining padded cloth and the Mystic Forge

name: Demonic Metal Rod
description: The remnants of a Zamorakian weapon. Perhaps you could learn something from it.

sources.notes: It is obtained through Evil Emporium for 300 Infernal Fragments. It can also be obtained through vestige chests in Dowdun Reach.

name: Demonic Oil
description: Made by combining necrotic bonemeal and vile ashes. A crafting component.

name: Dented White Pauldron
description: The ancient remnants of some sort of armour. Perhaps you could learn something from it.

name: Desert Cloth
description: A coarse but hard-wearing fabric made from local flora.

sources.notes: Desert cloth is created with a loom and is primarily used for power level 7 armour.

name: Desert Hood
description: A lightweight hood woven for the harsh desert sun. It shields the wearer from heat and drifting sands.

sources.notes: Desert hood is a power level 7 magic armour that can be crafted at an armour bench.

name: Desert Net
description: A reliable and hard-wearing net made from desert thread.

sources.notes: The desert net is a power level 7 Fishing tool crafted at the crafting table.

name: Desert Robe Legs
description: Lightweight leggings made for desert travel, offering protection from heat while allowing easy movement across the sand

sources.notes: Desert robe legs are a power level 7 magic armour that can be crafted at an armour bench.

name: Desert Robes
description: Loose-fitting and breathable, this robe protects against the sun's harsh glare while allowing air to flow freely.

sources.notes: Desert robes are a power level 7 magic armour that can be crafted at an armour bench.

name: Desert Thread
description: A strong but rough thread spun from desert weed.

sources.notes: Desert thread is a material item created at a spinning wheel.

name: Desert Weed
description: A hearty plant native to the region. Can be spun into a durable thread

sources.notes: Desert weed is a basic material gathered by picking up Desert Weeds located in the Umbral Sands region or by growing in any plot but grows best in a Yew Farming Plot.

name: Desert Weed Seeds
description: A handful of Desert Weed seeds. Equip and use them to scatter these into a farming plot and start growing!Best planted in Umbral Sand plots.

sources.notes: Desert weed seeds can be used to grow Desert Weed (Farming) in a farming plot.

name: Diamond
description: A rare and precious gem, coveted by jewelers.

sources.notes: Diamond is a gemstone that can be obtained from mining coal nodes. It can be found if the player has unlocked the Gem Prospector perk at level 16 Mining. It can be manually mined with an appropriate pickaxe or using the Rocksplosion spell.

name: Dihydrogen Monoxide
description: Why did they laugh when I bought this? Sold by local traders.

name: Dire Wolf Hide
description: The skin of a savage beast.

sources.notes: Dire wolf hide is dropped from a dire wolf and can be crafted into dire wolf leather at the tannery.

name: Dire Wolf Leather
description: The tanned hide of a savage beast.

sources.notes: Dire wolf leather can be created by tanning dire wolf hide at a tannery.

name: Dirty Water
description: A source of hydration, tainted by the residue of a cataclysmic event.

name: Discordant Residue
description: Obtained from creatures in Kuldra's Tower. A core component of vis cloth.

sources.notes: Discordant Residue is a material gathered from enemies and Chest within the Scorned Wilderness.

name: Door
description: Wall with a frame to which two doors can be attached.

name: Dorgeshuun Crossbow
description: The signature weapon of the Dorgeshuun Goblin tribe. It fires Bone bolts and is surprisingly well made!

sources.notes: The dorgeshuun crossbow is a power level 5 crossbow that can be crafted at a fletching bench. The recipe is obtained from the quest Even More Restless Ghosts.

name: Doric's Smithing Supplies
description: A cloth shoulder back[sic], contains useful smithing materials.

name: Doric's Superior Smithing Supplies
description: A cloth shoulder back[sic], contains useful smithing materials.

name: Dowdun Reach Cape
description: There is no better display of mastery of the Dowdun Reach area.

sources.notes: The Dowdun Reach cape is a cape that can be created by learning the vestige found in a chest in Dowdun Reach.

name: Draconic Leather
description: A sturdy leather made from draconic hide, or from tanning hard leather with dragon blood.

name: Draconic Leather Scraps
description: Scruffy organic bits and pieces that can be combined to make draconic leather.

name: Draconic Staff
description: An ancient dragonkin staff used by the mages of old.

sources.notes: The draconic staff is a power level 4 staff that can be crafted at a mystic forge. The recipe is unlocked after studying the parts of a sinister-looking staff, which can be found in a chest on the western wall outside of Skeklac Kara, the dragonkin vault in Ashien's Watch.

name: Draconic Vis Wax
description: Made in a brewing cauldron. Alongside vis fibres, it can be spun into vis cloth on a loom.

sources.notes: It can be crafted in a Brewing Cauldron.

name: Dragon Blood
description: Harvested from dragons and dragonwolves. Used as a tanning agent at the tannery.

sources.notes: Dragon blood is a drop from dragon wolves and dragons.

name: Dragon Crossbow
description: An exceptional crossbow crafted from dragon metal. The bolt arrives before the target realises it has been fired.

name: Dragon Full Helm
description: A fearsome helm forged from dragon metal. Protects your head. Dragons generally aim downwards.

sources.notes: It can only be obtained as a rare drop from the Queenslayer's Reward Pack.

name: Dragon Kiteshield
description: A dragon-forged kiteshield built to stand firm against overwhelming odds.

sources.notes: The dragon kiteshield is a power level 9 Shields that can be obtained during the Scorned Wilderness raid.

name: Dragon Med Helm
description: An imposing helm forged from legendary dragon metal.

name: Dragon Platebody
description: The centrepiece of the dragon armour set, forged to withstand blows that would cripple lesser warriors.

sources.notes: It can only be obtained as a rare drop from the Queenslayer's Reward Pack.

name: Dragon Platelegs
description: Dragon-forged platelegs offering exceptional protection without sacrificing mobility.

sources.notes: It can only be obtained as a rare drop from the Queenslayer's Reward Pack.

name: Dragon Scimitar
description: A razor-sharp dragon scimitar favoured by warriors who value speed as much as strength.

name: Dragon Slayer Reward Pack
description: A cloth shoulder bag.

name: Dragon Tooth
description: A piece of dragon tooth, extracted from a dragon skull found in the Highlands.

sources.notes: Dragon teeth can be obtained either by mining teeth from the head of the dragon skull in the Stormtouched Highlands or by killing lesser dragons. Players will need to have an iron pickaxe to mine this item. Beyond the Ghornfell region, players can obtain this item as a mob drop from defeating lesser dragon mini-bosses.

name: Dragonbane Cape
description: A badge of honor for those who completed all challenges during the closed Alpha Test.

sources.notes: The cape can only be crafted and worn by those with the Alpha Challenge Cape DLC installed.

name: Dragonblight Shield
description: The Spirit of Velgar lives on within this shield, corrupting your enemies.

sources.notes: The dragonblight shield is a power level 4 masterwork shield that can be crafted at a blacksmith's bench after obtaining a noxious draconic visage from the Dragon Slayer reward pack by completing Dragon Slayer or from turning in Velgar's head to the Wise Old Man afterwards.

name: Dragonbone Dagger
description: A ferocious blade, filled with primal draconic rage.

sources.notes: The dragonbone dagger is a power level 4 one-handed melee weapon that can be crafted at a blacksmith's bench. The recipe can be found in Chaktan Kara, the dragonkin vault in northwest Stormtouched Highlands.

name: Dragoncurse Shield
description: The spirit of Imaru lives on within this shield.

sources.notes: The dragoncurse shield is a power level 5 masterwork shield that is obtained from the Withering Heights reward pack by completing Withering Heights. It can be crafted at a blacksmith's bench after obtaining an undead draconic visage from the same pack or from turning in Imaru's head to Death afterwards, although it will require another anti-dragon shield.

name: Dragonfire Shield
description: A shield forged in the wake of Fuzan's fall. Its scales still glow with a smoldering heat, as though the dragon's fury refuses to fade.

sources.notes: The dragonfire shield is a power level 7 masterwork shield that is obtained from the Icthlarin's Little Helper reward pack by completing Icthlarin's Little Helper. It can be crafted at a blacksmith's bench after obtaining a smouldering draconic visage from the same packThis is missing from the pack, a known bug.

name: Dragonkin Gargoyle 01
description: A fearsome dragonkin sculpture to decorate your wall.

sources.notes: Dragonkin gargoyle 01 is created by first learning the blueprint, found in chests near Fractured Plains or inside vaults.

name: Dragonkin Gargoyle 02
description: A sinister dragonkin sculpture to decorate your wall.

sources.notes: Dragonkin gargoyle 02 is created by first learning the blueprint, found in chests near Fractured Plains or inside vaults.

name: Dragonkin Gargoyle 03
description: A mysterious dragonkin sculpture to decorate your wall.

sources.notes: Dragonkin gargoyle 03 is created by first learning the blueprint, found in chests near Fractured Plains or inside vaults.

name: Dragonkin Mage Hood
description: A hood styled after the ancient overlords of Ashenfall.

sources.notes: Dragonkin mage hood is a power level 4 magic armour that can be created at an armour bench. The recipe can be found in Chaktan Kara, a dragonkin vault.

name: Dragonkin Mage Robe Legs
description: Leggings styled after the ancient overlords of Ashenfall.

sources.notes: Dragonkin mage robe legs are a power level 4 magic armour that can be created at an armour bench. The recipe can be found in Chaktan Kara, a dragonkin vault.

name: Dragonkin Mage Robes
description: Robes styled after the ancient overlords of Ashenfall.

sources.notes: Dragonkin mage robes is a power level 4 Magic robe that can be created at an armour bench. The recipe can be found in Chaktan Kara, a dragonkin vault.

name: Dragonkin Obelisk 01
description: A strange obelisk of dragonkin design. Its purpose remains unknown.

sources.notes: Dragonkin obelisk 01 is created by first learning the blueprint, found in chests near the Fractured Plains or inside vaults.

name: Dragonkin Obelisk 02
description: An enigmatic obelisk of dragonkin design. No one knows what it does.

sources.notes: The recipe is obtained after using the Dragonkin Obelisk 02 Plan, which can be found in chests within the Skeklac Kara, Takla Kara, and Chaktan Kara vaults.

name: Dragonkin Obelisk 03
description: A mysterious obelisk of dragonkin design. Form or function? No one knows.

sources.notes: Dragonkin obelisk 03 is created by first learning the blueprint, found in chests near Fractured Plains or inside vaults.

name: Dragonkin Statue 01
description: An ancient dragonkin sculpture.

sources.notes: Dragonkin statue 01 is created by first learning the blueprint, found in chests near the Fractured Plains, or inside vaults.

name: Dragonkin Statue 02
description: The likeness of an ancient race, captured forever in time.

sources.notes: Dragonkin statue 02 is created by first learning the blueprint, found in chests near the Fractured Plains, or inside vaults.

name: Dragonslayer's Cape
description: Awarded to those who have faced Queen Kuldra and Emerged victorious. Few Capes carry greater prestige.

sources.notes: The Dragonslayer's Cape is a prestigious back slot item crafted at the Armour Bench following the defeat of Queen Kuldra in the Regicide quest.

name: Dragonstone
description: A rare and precious gem, coveted by jewelers.

sources.notes: Dragonstone is a gemstone obtained from mining adamant ore nodes. It can be found if the player has unlocked the Gem Prospector perk at level 16 Mining. It can be manually mined with an appropriate pickaxe or using the Rocksplosion spell.

name: Dragonwolf Hide
description: Dropped from felled draconic beasts. Can be processed at the tannery.

sources.notes: Dragonwolf hide is a drop from dragon wolves and Doric's smithing supplies.

name: Dried Cadavaberries
description: Probably not poisonous. A neat little snack.

name: Dried Dwellberries
description: Sweet and chewy, a great fruity snack.

name: Dried Giant Krill
description: Krills hunger with one bite. Grants the Sea Legs perk.

name: Dried Peach
description: A tasty dried fruit.

name: Dried Redberries
description: A little sour, but a tasty snack.

name: Dried Tea Leaves
description: |weight = 0.0

name: Druid's Bandosian Amulet
description: A goblin artefact, found on a druid.

sources.notes: It is one of two amulets; the other amulet is found in a reliquary at Bramblemead ruins.

name: Dual Tall Slit Wall
description: A stylish castle wall.

name: Dubious Meat Pie
description: Pastry makes everything better.

name: Dust-covered Sketchbook
description: A ruined notebook, buried beneath the soil.

sources.notes: The dust-covered sketchbook is a quest item that is found at Coalridge Pass, south-east of the ridge of the map. Once players have entered the cave with the coal, iron, and granite nodes, they will need to turn left and either cast Rocksplosion or mine away the granite deposits on top of the iron ore node and interact with the old book.

name: Dusty Black Pocket
description: The remnants of Zamorakian chaps. Perhaps you could learn something from it.

sources.notes: It is obtained through Evil Emporium for 300 infernal fragments.

name: Dwellberries
description: Some rather pretty blue berries.

sources.notes: They can be collected from dwellberry bushes in Fractured Plains and Stormtouched Highlands, Farmed from dwellberries (Farming) grown from dwellberry seeds, and found in chests in Ghornfell.

name: Dwellberry Crunchies
description: Yum... smells fruity.

name: Dwellberry Crunchies (Removed)
description: Yum... smells fruity.

sources.notes: Dwellberry crunchies are a consumable food item that can be created through Cooking by combining dwellberries and either cabbages or potatoes at a cooking pot.

name: Dwellberry Glazed Roast Flank
description: A delicious flank steak, covered in a fruity dwellbery[sic] glaze. Mouthwateringly tasty!

name: Dwellberry Glazed Roast Meat
description: A juicy piece of roasted meat with a deliciously fruity dwellberry glazing. Scrumptious!

sources.notes: Dwellberry glazed roast meat is a food item that can be created through Cooking, by combining dwellberries with any tier one meat (raw rat meat, raw bird meat, raw farm meat, or raw game meat) at a cooking pot.

name: Dwellberry Infusion
description: A refreshing, fruity drink. Good for hydration.

name: Dwellberry Infusion (decoration)
description: A bottle of delicious purple juice to decorate your home with.

name: Dwellberry Seeds
description: A dwellberry seed. Equip and use them to scatter these into a farming plot and start growing! Best planted in Ghornfell plots.

sources.notes: Dwellberry seeds can be obtained from harvesting wild dwellberry bushes.

name: Earth Rune
description: A symbol of the earth's might, essential for earth-based magic. Runes are retained if you happen to die

sources.notes: Earth runes can be crafted at a rune altar at level 15 Runecrafting or higher.

name: Earth Rune (Decoration)
description: Earth rune is a decoration that is unlocked once the player has received an earth rune in their inventory for the first time.

name: Ectoplasm
description: Dropped from aggressive spirits or extracted from wither hearts. Used in crafting.

sources.notes: Ectoplasm is a basic material dropped by Spirits such as lost souls or acquired by processing one withered heart in a kiln for a yield of three.

name: Egg
description: A nutritious ingredient.

sources.notes: They are found in bird nests from trees, dropped by chickens in Bramblemead Valley and Dowdun Reach, and from terrorbirds in the Fractured Plains.

name: Eggs Royale
description: Made by combining fried egg and fried salmon. Grants the Sea Life perk.

name: Elder Curiosities
description: Obsidian curiosities that feel pleasing in the hand. Can be ground and smelted into pure obsidian.

sources.notes: Elder curiosities is a basic item obtained from kot packs dropped by KotHaar sentinels or from chests found in Umbral Sands.

name: Elongated Obsidian Construct
description: Perhaps you could learn something from it.

sources.notes: It can be received as a drop by KotHaar-Hur and KotHaar-Xil in Umbral Sands.
They currently cannot be legitimately obtained.

name: Empty Vial
description: Apparently this will collect lightning if you get struck by it.

sources.notes: Empty Vial is a quest item that is obtained by Doctor Fenkenstrain in The Great Body Robbery.

name: Enchanted Adamant Bolt
description: Adamant bolts infused with sanguine energy and a ruby tip. Drains some of the archers health to increase the bolts damage.

sources.notes: Enchanted Adamant Bolt is a power level 7 bolt crafted at a Fletching Bench.

name: Enchanted Blurite Bolts
description: Blurite crossbow bolts tipped with enchanted Jade, that have a chance of dealing Earth magic damage and knocking your target down.

name: Enchanted Bronze Bolts
description: Bronze crossbow bolts tipped with enchanted opal. These have a chance to summon a lightning strike around your target, dealing Air Magic Damage to all nearby enemies.

name: Enchanted Iron Bolts
description: Iron crossbow bolts tipped with enchanted Jade, that have a chance of dealing Water magic damage and slowing your target.

name: Enchanted Mithril Bolts
description: These crossbow bolts offer a chance to create a toxic burst, poisoning all nearby enemies.

sources.notes: Enchanted mithril bolts are a power level 6 ammunition crafted at a fletching bench that has a 15% chance to create a toxic burst, poisoning all nearby enemies within a 4-5 meter radius.

name: Enchanted Rune Bolt
description: Rune bolts infused with magical energy and a diamond tip. Their targets rarely appreciate the distinction. Has a chance to pierce through several enemies at once.

sources.notes: Enchanted rune bolts are a power level 8 ammunition crafted at a fletching bench.

name: Enchanted Steel Bolts
description: Steel crossbow bolts tipped with enchanted red topaz. Has a chance to create a necrotic bolt that heals you for a porportion of the damage dealt.

name: Evasive Infusion
description: A thirst-quenching drink that improves your reflexes.

name: Evasive Infusion (decoration)
description: A bottle of energetic liquid to decorate your home with.

name: Eventide - A New Spawn
description: A sealed scroll full of the worst things imaginable.

sources.notes: Eventide - A New Spawn is a quest item obtained on the desk in the ruins by Razlem, the Deranged.

name: Extinguished Blue Remnants
description: A long extinguished torch with unique charactersitics[sic].

sources.notes: The extinguished blue remnants is a vestige found by looting Buried Chests in Brynmoor and Ghornfell.

name: Extinguished Green Remnants
description: A long extinguished torch with unique charactersitics[sic].

sources.notes: The extinguished green remnants is a vestige found by looting Buried Chests in Brynmoor and Ghornfell.

name: Extinguished Purple Remnants
description: A long extinguished torch with unique charactersitics[sic].

sources.notes: The extinguished purple remnants is a vestige found by looting Buried Chests in Brynmoor and Ghornfell.

name: Extinguished Red Remnants
description: A long extinguished torch with unique charactersitics[sic].

sources.notes: The extinguished red remnants is a vestige found by looting Buried Chests in Brynmoor and Ghornfell.

name: Extinguished Yellow Remnants
description: A long extinguished torch with unique charactersitics[sic].

sources.notes: The extinguished yellow remnants is a vestige found by looting Buried Chests in Brynmoor and Ghornfell.

name: Fabric That Hums With You
description: The remnants of a Zamorakian mage hood. Perhaps you could learn something from it.

sources.notes: It is obtained through Evil Emporium for 200 infernal fragments.

name: Fallen Hoplite's Aspis
description: The shield of an Undead Hoplite.

sources.notes: The fallen hoplite's aspis is a power level 5 shield that can be crafted at a blacksmith's bench after obtaining a sundering spiked slab as a rare drop (5/100) from a skeletal hoplite.

name: Fallen Hoplite's Chest
description: Melee chest armour once belonging to a long dead Saradomin Hoplite.

sources.notes: Fallen hoplite's chest is a power level 5 melee armour that can be crafted at an armour bench. It can be obtained by interactng with a dragonkin effigy within the vault. The dragonkin effigy can be found behind a breakable wall, near the two diamond door with a distinct circular cracked pattern.

name: Fallen Hoplite's Helm
description: A Melee helmet once belonging to a long dead Saradomin Hoplite.

sources.notes: Fallen Hoplite's Helm is a power level 5 melee armour that can be crafted at an armour bench. It can be obtained by interacting with a dragonkin effigy within the vault. The Effigy can be found up a path revealed (while soulrifted) above the spectral door in the room you jump down into after the fight with the rotsworn necromancer.

name: Fallen Hoplite's Tassets
description: Melee leg armour once belonging to a long dead Saradomin Hoplite.

sources.notes: Fallen hoplite's tassets are a power level 5 melee armour that can be crafted at an armour bench. It can be obtained by interacting with a dragonkin effigy within the vault, which can be found up the stairs in the main room then Windstep to the north-Western platforms.

name: Fancy Rug
description: A nicer rug to decorate your floor.

name: Fang Arrow
description: Arrows with tips carved from animal fangs.

sources.notes: Fang arrows are power level 2 ammunition crafted at a fletching bench.

name: Fang Barbed Arrow
description: Arrows with tips carved from animal fangs.

sources.notes: Fang barbed arrows are fang arrows with weapon barbs crafted on the arrow.

name: Fang Fire Arrow
description: Arrows with tips carved from animal fangs.

name: Farmer's Hat
description: A delightful piece of headwear, popular with those who toil the land.

sources.notes: Farmer's hat is a power level 1 head armour which can be crafted using a crafting table.

name: Farming Cape
description: Congratulations! Reaching level 99 in Farming is an astonishing feat. Wear this cape with pride.

sources.notes: The Farming cape is a Cape of Accomplishment able to be crafted and worn at level 99 Farming. It can be crafted at the mystic forge. Trimmed version of the cape can be crafted the same way if you have more than one skill at 99.

name: Feather Bait
description: What is it about feathers that fascinates a fish? A great way to bait them. Trout seems the most susceptible. increases the catch chance of this fish.

sources.notes: Feather bait is a power level 2 Fishing bait crafted at the crafting table.

name: Feathered Lure
description: Entice Salmon with a knotted ball of bird knock-offs. Increases the catch chance of this fish.

sources.notes: Feathered lures are a power level 3 Fishing bait crafted at the crafting table.

name: Feathers
description: Gathered from avian creatures and nests. Feathers are used to fletch arrows.

sources.notes: Feathers are obtained by killing birds, such as chickens and terrorbirds, and used to fletch arrows.

name: Fellhollow Cape
description: A cloak depicting the ethereal beauty of Fellhollow.

sources.notes: The recipe is unlocked by acquiring the Fell Cape Pattern, found in a chest buried under a pile of Rocks along the spine of the dragon skeleton, south of Imaru's Tower.

name: Fence
description: A simple fence to keep critters out.

name: Ferocious Infusion
description: A hydrating drink infused with primal fury.

name: Ferocious Infusion (decoration)
description: A bottle of surprisingly angry liquid to decorate your home with.

name: Fibrous Pipe Cactus
description: A complex network of fibres and water reservoirs. Can be tanned to produce a durable material.

sources.notes: Fibrous pipe cactus can be found west of the Moon Garou tribe near a grove of yew trees, and can be used to make 3 cactus fibres in a tannery.

name: Fillet
description: Roasted bird meat. Tastes like everything tastes.

name: Fine Cloth
description: Woven from fine thread and gold. Used in weapon and armour crafting.

sources.notes: Fine cloth is created with a loom with a Loom Harness next to it, requiring three fine thread.

name: Fine Net
description: Made with two fine threads at a crafting table. An elegant little net.

sources.notes: The fine net is a power level 5 Fishing tool crafted at the crafting table.

name: Fine Thread
description: Made from spun corpse cotton. Can be used as a bow string and in stitching weapons and gear.

sources.notes: Fine thread is a material item created at a spinning wheel. It can be crafted using 4 corpse cotton, creating a single fine thread.

name: Fire Cape
description: Receiving or blocking damage has a chance to triggering burning on your attacker. Melee kills on Burning enemies refill stamina.

sources.notes: It is the only cape in the game that is dropped by a boss monster.

name: Fire Oil
description: Flammable and volatile, handle with care! Used to craft Fire arrows.

name: Fire Rune
description: Equippable as ammo when using a magic weapon (provided the required skill perk is unlocked).A symbol of blazing heat, essential for fire-based magic. Runes are retained if you happen to die.

sources.notes: Fire runes can be crafted at a rune altar at level 25 Runecrafting or higher, and can deal between 6-10 base damage, along with whatever staves the player equips.

name: Fire Rune (Decoration)
description: Fire rune is a decoration that is unlocked once the player has received a fire rune in their inventory for the first time.

name: Fish Fry
description: Made by combining roasted lobster, braised undead eel and fried cabbage.

sources.notes: Fish fry is a consumable food item that provides 180 health and 55 sustenance.

name: Fishing Barrel
description: A simple barrel to store raw fish in.

sources.notes: The fishing barrel is a storage container that can hold up to 48 raw fish. It becomes available once players reach level 34 in the Fishing skill.

name: Fishing Cape
description: Congratulations! Reaching level 99 in Fishing is an astonishing feat. Wear this cape with pride.

sources.notes: The Fishing cape is a Cape of Accomplishment able to be crafted and worn at level 99 Fishing. It can be crafted at the mystic forge. Trimmed version of the cape can be crafted the same way if you have more than one skill at 99.

name: Flank Steak
description: A thick and juicy steak.

name: Flax
description: Harvested from flax plants, essential for crafting linen and bowstrings.

sources.notes: Flax can be found by harvesting the flax plants in either Bramblemead Valley, Fractured Plains, or Stormtouched Highlands.

name: Flax Seeds
description: Flax seeds. Equip and use them to scatter these into a farming plot and start growing! Best Planted in Brynmoor plots.

sources.notes: Flax seeds can be used to grow flax (Farming) in a farming plot. Flax seeds can be obtained from harvesting wild flax plants.

name: Fleece
description: Raw sheepskin that can be processed into wool.

sources.notes: Fleece is a basic material, gathered from killing rams and sheep.

name: Fleet-Footed Infusion
description: A thirst-quenching drink that puts a spring in your step.

name: Fleet-Footed Infusion (decoration)
description: A bottle of fast-moving liquid to decorate your home with.

name: Fletching Bench
description: Used for fashioning bows and crossbows.

sources.notes: it can be placed without a foundation but must have a roof to use.

description: PERK: Focused AgilityGrants a 30% XP BOOST for the Agility Skill

name: Forager's Sandwich
description: A hunger-reducing snack made with fried cabbages and grilled mushrooms.

sources.notes: It is made with fried cabbage, grilled mushrooms, and bread in a cooking range after finding the recipe in the garrison in Dowdun Reach.

name: Fortifying Crunchies
description: PERK - FUNGAL FORTITUDE (300 SEC)Grants RESISTENCE to POISON effectsIt actually smells quite good.

name: Fortifying Soup
description: PERK - FUNGAL FORTITUDE (300 SEC)A warm vegetable soup, with added mushrooms.Grants RESISTENCE[sic] to POISON effects

name: Fortifying Stew
description: PERK - FUNGAL FORTITUDE (300 SEC)Grants RESISTENCE[sic] to POISON effectsA warm meat and mushroom stew, fortifies you against the trials ahead.

name: Fractured Cape
description: A cloak warning against the danger of hubris.

sources.notes: The recipe is unlocked by acquiring the PATTERN: fractured cape, found in a chest at the north-north-east tip of the Fractured Plains.

name: Fractured Obsidian Construct
description: Perhaps you could learn from it[sic]

name: Fried Cabbage
description: Yum! Maybe I do like cabbage.

name: Fried Egg
description: Sunny side up.

name: Fried Onions
description: A pungent meal that brings a tear to your eye.

name: Fried Salmon
description: For when you feel like a hungry bear. Grants the Sea Life perk.

name: Fried Sardine
description: Delicious little fishies. Grants the Warding Fish perk.[sic]

sources.notes: It is made by cooking raw sardine on either a campfire or a grill, and is used in sauteed sardines and lesser Focused Fishing potion.

name: Fruit Pie
description: A fruit party, wrapped in golden pastry.

name: Fuel Briquette
description: Produced by burning wood in a kiln, charcoal is a very efficient fuel.

name: Fuel Pellet
description: A high-temperature fuel. Needed to smelt more advanced metals.

sources.notes: Fuel pellet is a fuel source that can be created at a Blacksmiths Bench.

name: Furnace
description: By burning charcoal to create a blazing hot flame, the furnace is able to fire clay, and smelt ores into metal bars.

sources.notes: If you want to see the one capable of smelting higher materials, please see blast furnace. It requires charcoal to operate, which can be obtained using the kiln.

name: Fuzan's Head
description: It's tempting to leave it out in the Scorch to give it a taste of its own medicine.

sources.notes: Fuzan's head is a quest item obtained during Icthlarin's Little Helper after defeating Fuzan.

name: Garou Arms
description: A pair of well-preserved garou arms, the perfect gift for any mad scientist.

name: Garou Artifact
description: An object of garou origin that might hold value with local traders.

sources.notes: Garou artifact is an item found in Umbral Sands.

name: Garou Chit
description: A local currency favoured by garou traders.

name: Garou Drum
description: Add a little music to your home.

name: Garou Hanging Ornament 01
description: Decorate your home with tasteful hanging bones.

sources.notes: Garou hanging ornament 01 is created by first learning the blueprint, found in chests near Fractured Plains or inside vaults.

name: Garou Hanging Ornament 02
description: Decorate your home with tasteful hanging bones.

description: Decorate your home with tasteful hanging bones.

sources.notes: Garou hanging ornament 04 is created by first learning the blueprint, found in chests near Fractured Plains or inside vaults.

name: Garou Highborn's Cloak
description: A cloak worn by garou nobility.

sources.notes: Additional ones can also be crafted via the Armour Bench after the quest.

name: Garou Pack
description: A brutal bag sewn from hide and sinew.

sources.notes: A garou pack is dropped from killing garou berserkers, garou druids, garou hunters, garou thanes, and the Garou King.

name: Garou Stool
description: A comfortable stool with only a few claw marks.

name: Garou Trophy 01
description: Decorate your home with your hunting victories!

sources.notes: Garou trophy 01 is created by first learning the blueprint, found in chests near the Fractured Plains, or inside vaults.

name: Garou Trophy 02
description: Show off your hunting prowess with a tasteful trophy.

sources.notes: Garou trophy 02 is created by first learning the blueprint, found in chests in Ghornfell or inside vaults.

name: Garou Trophy 03
description: A trophy to remember your most difficult hunts.

sources.notes: Garou trophy 03 is created by first learning the blueprint, found in chests near the Fractured Plains or inside vaults.

name: Garou Trophy 04
description: What better way to decorate your home than with the bones of the dead?

sources.notes: Garou trophy 04 is created by first learning the blueprint, found in chests near the Fractured Plains or inside vaults.

name: Garou Tusks 01
description: Add some primordial flare to your home with this decoration.

sources.notes: Garou tusks 01 is created by first learning its blueprint, found in chests near the Fractured Plains or inside vaults.

name: Garou Tusks 02
description: Decorate your home with a pile of bones. It's the latest fashion.

sources.notes: Garou tusks 02 is created by first learning its blueprint, found in chests near the Fractured Plains or inside vaults.

name: Garou Tusks 03
description: Scare your in-laws with a sinister pile of bones!

sources.notes: Garou tusks 03 is created by first learning its blueprint, found in chests near the Fractured Plains, or inside vaults.

name: Garou Wall Banner
description: Decorate your home with the embroidery skills of the beastmen of Ashenfall.

name: Garou Wall Pelt
description: Hang your kills on the wall for all to see.

name: Garou Weave
description: A high quality material sold by local garou merchants.

sources.notes: Garou weave can be bought from the merchants Iasadair, Beartach and Domri or found in chests in Umbral Sands and is primarily used for power level 7 armour.

name: Ghostspeak Amulet
description: An amulet you found in a well in Brynmoor.

sources.notes: The amulet can be found by interacting with a crumbling well in the ruins of the town of Brynmoor in Bramblemead Valley, near where the Wise Old Man can be found.

name: Giant Krill Bait
description: If I told you why this bait works, I'd have to krill you. Infernal Eels look alive! Increases the catch chance of this fish.

sources.notes: Giant krill bait is a power level 6 Fishing bait crafted at the crafting table.

name: Gilded Gyrhawk Amulet
description: While wearing this amulet, Warped Feathers are consumed to award additional XP while exploring the world. Additionally increases the amount of experience gained from courses.

sources.notes: The gilded gyrhawk amulet is an amulet that can be crafted at a jeweler's bench after obtaining gold record times on all available Agility courses.

name: Gilded Paladin Cape
description: A magnificent cape trimmed in gold, worn by those who wish to stand apart from the crowd.

sources.notes:
The Gilded Paladin Cape is a cape that requires no materials to craft and can be crafted at the Crafting Table and the Mystic Forge

The recipe for this item is obtained from purchasing the Deluxe Edition.

name: Gilded Paladin Chestpiece
description: An ornate golden chestpiece that serves as a symbol of power, status, and confidence.

sources.notes: The gilded paladin chestpiece is a power level 4 melee armour piece that can be crafted with an armour bench. The recipe for this item is obtained from purchasing the Deluxe Edition.

name: Gilded Paladin Helmet
description: Polished to a brilliant shine, this helmet is as impressive as it is eye-catching.

sources.notes: The gilded paladin helmet is a power level 4 melee armour piece that is crafted with an armour bench. The recipe for this item is obtained from purchasing the Deluxe Edition.

name: Gilded Paladin Legs
description: Golden platelegs for warriors who believe protection should be seen from a distance.

sources.notes: The gilded paladin legs is a power level 4 melee armour piece that can be crafted with an armour bench. The recipe for this item is obtained from purchasing the Deluxe Edition.

name: Glass Decoration
description: A delightful ornament that will really tie your home together.

sources.notes: A glass decoration is an item that can be crafted using molten glass at the jeweler's bench.

name: Glass Owl
description: A handcrafted owl made of glass. It seems to have great sentimental value to someone.

sources.notes: The glass owl is obtained by digging the grave west of the blue dragon spawn in the west of the Library region.

name: Glass Pane
description: It's transparent that you're going to use this when building.

sources.notes: Glass panes is created with molten glass at a jeweler's bench, and are used in construction.

name: Glass Vessel
description: A glass item made by glassblowing.

sources.notes: Glass vessels can be created with molten glass at a jeweler's bench, and can be used for various recipes.

name: Glazed Pumpkin Sandwich
description: A warming dish made with roast pumpkin, maple syrup and dried redberry.

sources.notes: It is made with dried redberries, roast pumpkin, maple syrup, and bread in a cooking range after finding the recipe nearby Zanik in the Dowdun Reach underground.

name: Goblin "Swingslash"
description: A surprisingly nasty little axe. Popular with goblin warriors.

sources.notes: The goblin "Swingslash" is a power level 2 one-handed melee weapon that can be crafted at a crafting table. The recipe is learned by consuming a cruel goblin blade, received as a random drop from a goblin pack; the drop chance for this vestige is 2%.

name: Goblin Legs
description: A pair of worryingly fresh goblin legs. Doctor Fenkenstrain will be interested in these.

name: Goblin Pack
description: A cloth shoulder bag, grimy and poorly kept.

sources.notes: A goblin pack is dropped from killing goblin warriors, goblin archers, goblin runts, and goblin bruisers.

name: Goblin War Banner
description: A cloak reminding us that even gods can be forgotten.

sources.notes: Additional ones can also be crafted via the Armour Bench after the quest.

name: Gold Bar
description: A precious metal found in the deepest parts of Ghornfell; used for crafting valuable items.

name: Gold Bar (decoration)
description: A gold bar to place around your home.

sources.notes: The gold bar decoration does not need a foundation and can be built either indoors or outdoors.

name: Gold Leaf
description: A thin sheet of brilliant gold, can be used for demonstrating your prowess, potion making or even recycling into gold bars.

sources.notes: To obtain these, players must either collect them from golden reward packs or recycle gold bars at the jeweler's bench to make sheets of ten per bar.

name: Gold Medal
description: thumb|The icon for the Gold Medal in the building menu.

name: Gold Ore
description: Mined from gold deposits. It can be smelted at a Furnace.

sources.notes: Gold ore is a basic Mining material mined from Gold Ore Nodes, which can be mainly found in the Bloodblight Swamp. It can be smelted at a furnace to make gold bars.

name: Gold Salvage Pile
description: Scraps that can be searched through. All that glitters may not be gold.

sources.notes: Gold salvage piles are a basic material, nine of them can be smelted in a furnace to create one gold bar.

name: Gourmand Ring
description: No effect

name: Granite
description: A dense stone used for construction and crafting. Very commonly found underground, in mines and dungeons.

sources.notes: Granite is a basic Mining material that can be mined from granite deposits.

name: Granite Maul
description: The power of this warhammer should not be taken for granite.

name: Grated Floor
description: Sturdy surface used to create floors.

name: Grave 01
description: Be careful where you step, someone sleeps below. A decoration for the spookier home.

sources.notes: Grave 01 is a decoration unlocked by reading PLAN: grave 1 which is found in a spectral chest in Fellhollow.

description: A memorial to the lost. A decoration for the more maudlin home.

name: Green Adventurer's Cape
description: A simple, yet stylish accessory.

name: Green Chandelier
description: A chandelier that can be hung from the ceiling.

sources.notes: A green chandelier is a constructed object that can be built only indoors, and requires the player to place it under a horizontally flat foundation (e.g., square tile, square foundation, etc.)

name: Green Desert Cape
description: A Green cape, stitched in an ancient desert style. Its patterns reflect a long-standing mastery of life beneath the scorching sun.

sources.notes: The recipe is unlocked after studying the green memory of Menaphos vestige, which can be found in chests in Umbral Sands.

name: Green Dragon Hide
description: Obtained from felled Lesser Green Dragons. Can be processed at the Tannery.

sources.notes: Green dragon hide is a basic material dropped by green dragons which can be tanned to create green dragonhide leather.

name: Green Dragonhide Body
description: Ranged body armour crafted from Green Dragonhide. Form-fitting yet intimidating.

sources.notes: Green dragonhide body is power level 5 ranged armour that can be created at an armour bench. The recipe is unlocked upon obtaining green dragon hide.

name: Green Dragonhide Chaps
description: Agile Ranged leg armour crafted from Green Dragonhide.

name: Green Dragonhide Coif
description: Lightweight Ranger headgear crafted from Green Dragonhide for Ranged users.

sources.notes: Green dragonhide coif is a power level 5 ranged armour that can be created at an armour bench. The recipe is unlocked upon obtaining green dragon hide.

name: Green Dragonhide Leather
description: Made by tanning Green Dragonhide. A key crafting component for armour.

sources.notes: Green dragonhide leather is a Processed material created from tanning green dragon hide.

name: Green Dyad Cape
description: A cape made for its looks more than any kind of magical potency.

name: Green Hex Cape
description: A cape made for its looks more than any kind of magical potency.

name: Green Memory of Menaphos
description: Perhaps you could learn something from it.

name: Green Standing Torch
description: A torch that can be placed on surfaces.

description: A torch that can be placed on surfaces.

name: Green Torch
description: A trusty lightsource - now in green.

name: Green Wall-mounted Torch
description: A torch that can be mounted on vertical surfaces.

name: Green Wall-mounted Torch (Dowdun Reach)
description: A torch that can be placed on surfaces.

name: Grieving Moonstaff
description: This staff is dedicated to Lougrim, the fallen Garou goddess of the Moon.

sources.notes: The grieving moonstaff is a power level 3 staff that can be crafted at a mystic forge. The recipe is unlocked after studying a mysterious crescent carving, which can be dropped by garou druids with a 2/100 drop chance.

name: Grill
description: A much improved home cooking fire with no need for fuel.

name: Grilled Mushrooms
description: A rich and earthy treat.

name: Grilled Tomatoes
description: Fire really brings out the flavour.

name: Grilled Trout
description: Stave off hunger with this tasty bite. Grants the Sea Life perk.[sic]

sources.notes: It is made by cooking raw trout on either a campfire or a grill, and is used in herb baked trout and Focused Fishing potion.

name: Grilled Undead Bass
description: Undead and makes you unhungry. Grants the Sea Life perk.

name: Grim Black Codpiece
description: The remnants of Zamorakian platelegs. Perhaps you could learn something from it.

sources.notes: It is obtained through Evil Emporium for 300 infernal fragments.

name: Grindstone
description: This tool can crush stone, bones, and other things, into fine dust.

name: Ground Clay
description: Pulverised stone, used in building, and as an Herblore ingredient.

name: Ground Dragon Tooth
description: The product of grinding dragon teeth. Essential for making draconic vis wax.

sources.notes: Ground Dragon Tooth is a processed material created at a grindstone from dragon tooth and is used in the creation of Draconic Vis Wax.

name: Ground Granite
description: Pulverised stone, used in building and as an ingredient in herblore.

sources.notes: Ground granite is created by putting granite in a grindstone.

name: Ground Gypsum
description: Ground from gypsum. This reagent seems to reflect light and therefore heat.

sources.notes: Ground gypsum is created by putting a gypsum in a grindstone.

name: Ground Limestone
description: Fine limestone ground from limestone. With the proper tools, it can be made into glass in the Blast Furnace.

name: Ground Obsidian
description: An object of pure, refined obsidian.

sources.notes: Ground obsidian is a basic item created by grounding elder curiosities or obsidian device in a grindstone.

name: Ground Rune Essence
description: Made by grinding rune essence. A component of black dragon leather.

name: Ground Sandstone
description: Fine sand ground from sandstone. With the proper tools, it can be made into glass in the Furnace.

name: Ground Stone
description: Pulverised stone, used in building, and as an Herblore ingredient.

name: Gypsum Wax
description: A marvel of alchemy that, once applied to equipment, adds durability in extreme conditions.

name: Gyrhawk Amulet
description: The gyrhawk amulet is an amulet that can be crafted at a crafting table.

sources.notes: The gyrhawk amulet is an amulet that can be crafted at a crafting table. To unlock the recipe, players must receive warped feathers in their inventory, found in reward packs after completing Agility courses.

name: Half Wall
description: Simple wall used to create structures.

name: Half Wall With Door Frame
description: Wall with a frame to which a door can be attached.

name: Half Wall With Window Frame
description: Wall with a frame to which a window can be attached.

name: Hanging Tools
description: A lovely place to hang your tools. A decoration for your home.

name: Hard Leather
description: Sturdy material for crafting durable armour.

name: Hard Leather Body
description: Durable armour crafted from hard leather.

description: Durable armour crafted from hard leather.

name: Hard Leather Cowl
description: A durable helmet crafted from hard leather.

sources.notes: Hard leather cowl is a power level 3 ranged armour that can be crafted at an armour bench.

name: Hard Leather Scraps
description: Dropped from beasts in Fellhollow. Combined at the Tannery to create hard leather.

sources.notes: Hard leather scraps are found by killing Zombie Cows and are used to create hard leather.

name: Hardy Weathered Shell
description: You can feel it pulling away from you. Perhaps you could learn from it.

name: Harmonised Compound
description: Made from discordant residue in a kiln. Can be combined with runic powder on an advanced spinning wheel.

sources.notes: Harmonised Compound is a processed material created at a kiln from discordant residue.

name: Harralander
description: A fragrant herb used in restorative potions.

sources.notes: Harralander is a herb that is harvested from Harralander plants, found primarily in the Whispering Swamp and can be bought from Domri - The Merchant for 6 garou chits.

name: Harralander Seeds
description: Harralander seeds. Equip and use them to scatter these into a farming plot and start growing! Best Planted in Brynmoor plots.

name: Haunch
description: Roasted game meat. Tender and tasty.

name: Headstone 01
description: A memorial to the lost. A decoration for the more maudlin home.

sources.notes: Headstone 01 is a decoration unlocked by reading PLAN: headstone 01 which is found in a spectral chest in Fellhollow.

name: Headstone 02
description: A memorial to the lost. A decoration for the more maudlin home.

sources.notes: Headstone 02 is a decoration unlocked by reading PLAN: headstone 02 which is found in a spectral chest in Fellhollow.

name: Healing Potion
description: Recovers some lost health. Made with irit and redberries.

name: Hearty Crunchies
description: Yum! Smells delicious!

sources.notes: Hearty crunchies are a food item that can be created through Cooking, by combining onions and either redberries or dwellberries at a cooking pot, and provides moderate sustenance and 5 lifeward when consumed.

name: Hearty Fortifying Soup
description: PERK - FUNGAL FORTITUDE (300 SEC)Grants RESISTANCE to POISON effectsA comforting vegetable soup with added mushrooms. Helps prepare you for a grueling day ahead.

sources.notes: Hearty fortifying soup is a consumable food item that can be crafted by combining bittercap mushrooms with onions at a cooking pot.

name: Hearty Soup
description: A comforting vegetable soup, reminds you of rainy days sat by the fire.

sources.notes: Hearty soup is a consumable food item that can be created through Cooking by combining onion with either potato or cabbage at a cooking pot and provides moderate sustenance and 5 lifeward when consumed.

name: Hearty Stew
description: A nice hot stew. A taste of home.

sources.notes: Hearty stew is a stew that can be created through Cooking by combining a meat with a vegetable at a cooking pot, and much like meat stew provides moderate sustenance and 5 lifeward when eaten, however to as opposed to meat stew at least one tier two ingredient is used, either the meat used is raw bestial meat or the vegetable used is onion, or both.

name: Herb Baked Trout
description: Made by combining grilled trout and a baked potato. Grants the Sea Life perk.[sic]

name: Herd Ring
description: No effect

name: Hermit Ring
description: No effect

name: Hollow Bark
description: Found lying around Fellhollow, around long-dead trees. Used in the crafting.

sources.notes: Hollow bark is a drop from dead trees.

name: Horizontal Thick Beam
description: Used to create a frame for structures and improve their stability.

name: Horizontal Thin Beam
description: Used to create a frame for structures and improve their stability.

name: Human Torso
description: A surprisingly well-preserved human torso, must be ancient. Doctor Fenkenstrain is looking for something just like it.

name: Hunter Stagbow
description: With it's[sic] aerodynamic antlers, this bow is very popular with garou scouts.

sources.notes: The hunter stagbow is a power level 4 longbow that can be crafted at a fletching bench. The recipe is learned by consuming a string of sinew, a vestige dropped by garou hunters with a 3/100 drop chance.

name: Icthlarian Fetish
description: Perhaps you could learn from it[sic]

name: Icthlarin's Little Helper Reward Pack
description: Icthlarin's Little Helper reward pack is an item given to the player upon completing the quest Icthlarin's Little Helper

name: Imaru's Head
description: Proof of your triumph over the Soul-Eater. It's dripping ectoplasm all over, you should probably get rid of it...

sources.notes: Imaru's head is a quest item that is obtained by killing Imaru during the Withering Heights quest.

name: Imaru's Talon
description: A Scimitar forged from the Visage of Imaru.

sources.notes: Imaru's talon is a power level 5 scimitar, crafted at a blacksmith's bench, after receiving the serrated claw as a drop from Imaru.

name: Imbued Granite Maul Head
description: A massive granite warhammer head. Garou masons imbue their stone weapons with wild anima to make them stronger than metal.

name: Imbued Leather Wrappings
description: Strips of imbued dire wolf leather for the grips of a granite maul. Infused with primal savagery.

name: Imbuing Barrel
description: A processing station that is capable of imbuing liquids with new properties over a long period of time.

sources.notes: It requires wild anima to operate, which can primarily be obtained by smelting 4 anima-infused bark in the kiln.

name: Infernal Fragment
description: Used to craft magical equipment. Postie Pete also has a use for them.

sources.notes: Infernal fragments is a type of currency used in Evil Emporium to purchase several item recipes, and capes - these can be found in chests within Dowdun Reach, or dropped by certain monsters, such as lesser demons, hellhounds, hellrats, Black Knights, Zamorakian acolytes, Mages of Zamorak and shardbound lesser demons.

name: Infinity Cloth
description: Named as such due to the infinite number of colours it features. It's quite garish.

sources.notes: Infinity cloth is created with a loom and is primarily used for power level 7 armour.
