name: Irit
description: Harvested from Thorny Irit Roots, used in potion making at the brewing cauldron.

name: Iron Arrow
description: Arrows with tips forged from iron.

sources.notes: Iron arrows are power level 4 ammunition that can be crafted at a fletching bench.

name: Iron Bar
description: A versatile metal used for crafting a wide range of durable items.

name: Iron Bar (decoration)
description: An iron bar to place around your home.

sources.notes: The iron bar decoration does not need a foundation and can be built either indoors or outdoors.

name: Iron Barbed Arrow
description: Lacerating arrows with barbed tips forged from iron.

sources.notes: Iron barbed arrows are iron arrows with weapon barbs crafted on the arrow.

name: Iron Bolts
description: Crossbow bolts made from iron.

name: Iron Chest
description: A moderately sized chest to store items in.

name: Iron Crossbow
description: A 1-Handed Crossbow made from Iron.

sources.notes: It is crafted at a fletching bench.

name: Iron Crossbow Limbs
description: A pair of iron crossbow limbs. Used in crafting an Iron Crossbow.

sources.notes: They are created at a blacksmith's bench.

name: Iron Dagger
description: A sharp, compact weapon, perfect for quick strikes in close combat.

sources.notes: The iron dagger is a power level 4 one-handed melee weapon that can be crafted at a blacksmith's bench.

name: Iron Fire Arrow
description: Burning arrows with tips forged from iron coated in fire oil.

name: Iron Greataxe
description: A massive, two-handed axe, capable of delivering devastating blows.

sources.notes: The iron greataxe is a power level 4 two-handed melee weapon that can be crafted at a blacksmith's bench.

name: Iron Greatsword
description: A well-balanced, large, imposing sword for skilled warriors.

sources.notes: The iron greatsword is a power level 4 two-handed melee weapon that can be crafted at the blacksmith's bench.

name: Iron Helmet
description: Protect your head with this sturdy iron headgear.

sources.notes: Iron helmet is a power level 4 armour piece that is crafted with a armour bench.

name: Iron Logging Axe
description: A durable tool for chopping trees, ideal for budding lumberjacks.

sources.notes: The iron logging axe is a power level 4 logging axe that can be crafted at a blacksmith's bench. Deals 30 damage when felling applicable trees, and 45 when overhead chopping to split them.

name: Iron Mace
description: Crush your foes with this heavy, spiked iron mace.

sources.notes: The iron mace is a power level 4 one-handed melee weapon that can be crafted at a blacksmith's bench.

name: Iron Med Helm
description: A dependable helm trusted by countless adventurers.

sources.notes: It can be crafted at an Armour Bench using 4 Iron Bar, 4 Hard Leather, 1 Padded Cloth, and 1 Vault Shard. The recipe for this item is obtained from purchasing the Deluxe Edition

name: Iron Ore
description: Mined from iron deposits. It can be smelted in a Furnace.

sources.notes: Iron ore is a basic Mining material that can be mined from iron ore nodes, which are mainly found all over the Stormtouched Highlands and Fellhollow. Three ores can be smelted in a furnace into an iron bar, or three can be combined with three coal in a blast furnace to create a steel bar.

name: Iron Pickaxe
description: Essential for mining hard, valuable rocks, this iron pickaxe is a miner's best friend.

sources.notes: An iron pickaxe is a power level 4 pickaxe that can be crafted at a blacksmith's bench. It can mine the same ores as the previous tiers, along with gold ore and dragon teeth, dealing 50 damage to minable ores, and 100 with a critical swing.

name: Iron Platebody
description: A heavy iron chestplate, providing superior protection in battle.

sources.notes: An iron platebody is a power level 4 armour piece that is crafted with a armour bench.

name: Iron Platelegs
description: Sturdy iron leg armour.

sources.notes: An iron platelegs is a power level 4 armour piece that is crafted with a armour bench.

name: Iron Salvage Pile
description: Scraps that can be searched through. There might be something of value in there.

sources.notes: Iron salvage piles are a basic material, nine of them can be smelted in a furnace to create one iron bar.

name: Iron Secateurs
description: A pair of gardening Secateurs that boost your harvesting yield while equipped.

sources.notes: Iron secateurs are a farming tool that boosts harvest yields, with the recipe unlocked at 42 Farming. Players can expect to receive a 25% yield increase when harvesting fully grown plants whilst wielding the secateurs and clicking the  left-click option on the harvestable crop.

name: Iron Shield
description: A reliable, durable shield crafted from iron; perfect for tanking big hits.

sources.notes: The iron shield is a power level 4 shield that can be crafted at a blacksmith's bench.

name: Iron Sword
description: A well-crafted iron blade for skilled combatants.

sources.notes: The iron sword is a power level 4 one-handed melee weapon that can be crafted at a blacksmith's bench.

name: Iron Warhammer
description: A brutal two-handed weapon, capable of smashing through enemy defences.

sources.notes: The iron warhammer is a power level 4 two-handed melee weapon crafted at a blacksmith's bench.

name: Jade
description: A rare gemstone used to craft enchanted jewellery.

sources.notes: Jade is a gemstone that can be obtained by mining iron ore nodes. It can be found if the player has unlocked the Gem Prospector perk at level 16 Mining. It can be mined both manually with an appropriate pickaxe and by using the Rocksplosion spell.

name: Jade (decoration)
description: Sparkle sparkle.

sources.notes: The jade decoration does not need a foundation and can be built either indoors or outdoors.

name: Jade Emblem
description: One of three emblem keys required to unlock a statue.

sources.notes: This emblem is found near the centre of Fractured Plains.

name: Jeweler's Bench
description: Used to craft magical items from previous metals and gems.

name: Kalphite Bait
description: Kalphite bait. Increases the catch chance of fish.

sources.notes: Kalphite bait is a power level 7 bait crafted at the crafting table.

name: Kalphite Carapace Chest
description: This chest armour is made from parts of the kalphites. Its durable but flexible nature makes it excellent for rangers.

sources.notes: Kalphite carapace chest is a power level 7 ranged armour that can be crafted at an armour bench.

name: Kalphite Carapace Helmet
description: This helmet is made from parts of the kalphites. Its durable but flexible nature makes it excellent for rangers

sources.notes: Kalphite carapace helmet is a power level 7 ranged armour that can be crafted at an armour bench.

name: Kalphite Carapace Legs
description: This leg armour is made from parts of the kalphites. Its durable but flexible nature makes it excellent for rangers.

sources.notes: Kalphite carapace legs is a power level 7 ranged armour that can be crafted at an armour bench.

name: Kalphite Ichor
description: A viscous, sticky fluid. Can be processed into a durable adhesive.

sources.notes: Kalphite ichor is a basic item obtained from kalphite enemies and kalphite eggs in Umbral Sands.

name: Kalphite Shell
description: A durable kalphite carapace, suitable for crafting.

name: Kalphite Shell Fragments
description: Shattered kalphite chitin. Could be salvaged with the right adhesive.

sources.notes: Kalphite shell fragments is a basic item obtained from kalphite enemies in Umbral Sands.
Kalphite wing is a basic item dropped by kalphite soldiers that can be processed at a grindstone into shimmerscale powder.

name: Keg Barrel
description: Tap this for infinite, delicious beer. Shame that the tap is sealed shut.

name: Keris
description: This dagger is thin and has a wavy edge to better slide through gaps in armour.

sources.notes: The recipe is learned from the corroded curved blade, found in the vault in southwest Umbral Sands, in the chest after the kalphite queen boss fight.

name: Kiln
description: This kiln can slowly burn wood resources such as logs or planks into charcoal - a highly efficient fuel source. Pottery pieces can also be fired in this kiln.

name: Kot Pack
description: To say that a Kot Pack is the belongings of a single KotHaar is something of a misrepresentation. You're actually holding the belongings of dozens of KotHaar, stretching back millennia. A KotHaar will carry the obsidian of their ancestors, which was reconstituted from their ancestors before them. The Kot Pack is a lineage, an ancestral record of the creature you killed. It puts things a little into perspective, and I'm sure you will treat it with the respect it deserves.

sources.notes: Kot packs are a drop from KotHaar sentinels, and contains elder curiosities, rune essence, and obsidian devices.

name: Kuldra's Head
description: One of Kuldra's many heads. It glares back at you with untold hatred, even in this decapitated state. Commander Zilyana should see this.

name: Kuldra's Wrath
description: A masterfully crafted wand, infused with the fury of Kuldra - channeling arcane power with terrifying efficiency.

name: Kwuarm
description: A bitter green herb used to make potions.

sources.notes: Kwuarm is a herb that must be farmed using kwuarm seeds found in Goblin, Garou, or skeleton packs.

name: Kwuarm Seeds
description: Kwuarm Seeds. Equip and use them to scatter these into a farming plot and start growing! Best planted in Ghornfell plots.

sources.notes: Kwuarm seeds can be obtained from a skeleton or garou pack, after discovering ash logs. When planted with the Farming skill, kwuarm seeds will grow into kwuarm.

name: Large Awning Roof
description: Provides shelter to things beneath it.

name: Large Blurite Bar Pile
description: A mountain of blurite bars.

name: Large Bronze Bar Pile
description: A mountain of bronze bars.

name: Large Gold Bar Pile
description: When you really want to show off your wealth, use a mountain of gold.

name: Large Iron Bar Pile
description: A mountain of iron bars. A popular display at blacksmith parties.

name: Large Silver Bar Pile
description: Reach for the moon with a mountain of silver bars.

name: Large Wardstone
description: Recharges your armour with a large amount of lifeward.

name: Large Water Barrel
description: A large barrel for storing greater amounts of Clean of Dirty Water, filled using Watering Cans.

name: Law Rune
description: Resource needed for teleportation.Runes are retained if you happen to die.

sources.notes: Law runes can be crafted at a rune altar at level 50 Runecrafting or higher.

name: Law Rune (Decoration)
description: Law rune is a decoration that is unlocked once the player has received a law rune in their inventory for the first time.

name: Laying Book
description: A book that's more furniture than literature to display in your home.

name: Leather
description: A basic crafting material created from animal hide; commonly used for making equipment.

sources.notes: Leather is created by putting animal hide or animal hide scraps into the tannery.

name: Leather Body
description: Protective armour made from leather.

sources.notes: Leather body is a power level 2 ranged armour that can be crafted at a crafting table.

name: Leather Chaps
description: Protective armour made from leather.

sources.notes: Leather chaps are a power level 2 ranged armour that can be crafted at a crafting table.

name: Leather Cowl
description: Protective armour made from leather.

sources.notes: Leather cowl is a power level 2 helmet that can be crafted at a crafting table.

name: Leather Shield
description: A slightly more refined and durable shield made from wood and tanned animal hide.

sources.notes: A leather shield is a power level 2 shield that can be crafted at a crafting table.

name: Leggings Of Lightness
description: Fabeled leggings that allow you to carry more!

sources.notes:
thumb|In game view of chest with recipe inside
The leggings of lightness are a piece of power level 1 leg armour, which can be crafted using a crafting table. The recipe is learned by consuming the suspiciously light tattered boots vestige, found in a chest atop the windmill in Temple Woods.

name: Leonard the Bound
description: The book squirms in your backpack, as though trying to escape.

sources.notes: Leonard the Bound is one of five books in in the quest What Remains is Written that players must find to return to Abraxus The Eternal. The book is found in the gateway south of Skekven Kara vault, a connecting area between the Lake of Lost Souls and Silverthorn Keep.

description: The letter is a quest item obtained by interacting with the postbox.

name: Lightning Rod
description: Protects you from nearby lightning strikes.

sources.notes: The lightning rod is a building item that can be obtained by completing The Great Body Robbery.

name: Lightning-in-a-bottle
description: A lightning bolt trapped in glass. It's best not to think too hard about the physics of it.

sources.notes: Lightning-in-a-bottle is a quest item that is obtained by getting struck by lightning with an empty vial in their inventory.

name: Limestone
description: Can be ground into ground limestone

sources.notes: Limestone is a basic Mining material mined from limestone rocks, found scattered across the Dowdun Reach region, typically beside bodies of water.

name: Limp Black Lining
description: The remnants of a Zamorakian body armour. Perhaps you could learn something from it.

sources.notes: It is obtained through Evil Emporium for 400 infernal fragments.

name: Lobster Bait
description: Scraps of lobster meat made into bait to draw in fish. A meal Undead Eels cannot resist. Increases the catch chance of this fish.

sources.notes: The lobster bait is a power level 5 Fishing bait crafted at the crafting table.

name: Lodestone
description: A powerful plinth for teleportation.

name: Loom
description: The device processes threads into textiles and cloth.

sources.notes: The loom is unlocked upon obtaining a bronze bar.

name: Loom Harness
description: A loom improvement. The loom harness grants an additional slot to the loom, allowing the loom to weave more complex textiles.

sources.notes: NOTE: To learn the recipe, you MUST first gather iron ore and smelt it into iron bars.
Lougrim memorial shrine is created by first learning the recipe from Ancamairon - Alcarrid Elder upon delivering Lougrim's Staff to him after defeating Kuldra.

name: Lougrim's Staff
description: The very staff that Lougrim carried to her death within Kuldra's belly.

sources.notes: Lougrim's Staff is a quest item obtainable through the Scorned Wilderness raid.

name: Lumber Backpack
description: Stylish? Yes! But not only that... A highly functional backpack that improves your luck with rare wood resource drops. It also lightens the weight of carried wood, and gives a gentle boost to woodcutting progression.

sources.notes: Equipping this grants a +10% reduction to the weight of carried wood, +10% increase to Woodcutting experience, +10% increase to the amount of wood received from chopping trees and +15% for special item drop chance.

name: Lumber Storage
description: A storage box that has a high capacity to store lumber.

name: Lumberjack Potion
description: PERK: Lumberjack IIREDUCES the STAMINA cost of WOODCUTTING by 66%

name: Luminite Ore
description: Mined from luminite deposits. A catalysing material that can help to make rare metals.

sources.notes: Luminite Ore is a Mining material that can be mined from Luminite Deposits, which are found within the Scorned Wilderness.

name: Lunar Garou Hat
description: A lunar-infused hood designed to complement the garou robes, Suitable for magic users, enhancing healing abilities at night.

sources.notes: Lunar Garou hat are a power level 7 magic armour that can be crafted at a armour bench.

name: Lunar Garou Robe Legs
description: Lunar-imbued leggings that complete the garou robe set. Suitable for magic users, enhancing healing abilities at night.

sources.notes: Lunar Garou robe legs are a power level 7 magic armour that can be crafted at an armour bench.

name: Lunar Garou Robes
description: Robes woven under the light of a full moon, imbued with the wild power of the garou. Suitable for magic users, enhancing healing abilities at night.

sources.notes: Lunar Garou robes are a power level 7 magic armour that can be crafted at an armour bench.

name: Magic Cape
description: Congratulations! Reaching level 99 in Magic is an astonishing feat. Wear this cape with pride.

sources.notes: The Magic cape is a Cape of Accomplishment able to be crafted and worn at level 99 Magic. It can be crafted at the mystic forge. Trimmed version of the cape can be crafted the same way if you have more than one skill at 99.

name: Magic Logs
description: Cut from magic trees. Can be crafted into various equipment.

sources.notes: Magic logs are obtained by chopping down Magic Trees, with a Rune Logging Axe or better.

name: Magic Longbow
description: The natural resilience of magic wood allows this bow to send arrows soaring over great distances.

name: Magic Shortbow
description: A shortbow made of magic wood, this bow is light enough to carry all day and powerful enough to ruin someone else's.

name: Magic Tree Seed
description: Magic tree seeds. Plant this directly into the ground to grow your own Tree!

sources.notes: A magic tree seed is an unreleased type of seed, intended for use with the Farming skill to grow a magic tree. It is expected to drop from magic trees with the 1.0.1 update.

name: Magical Focus
description: Imbue your staff to increase the damage of your magical attacks for a limited time.

name: Magnet
description: A Magnet smithed by Pulpknuckle.

sources.notes: Magnet  is a quest item required for Animal Magnetism, which is created by giving an iron bar and 5 law runes to Pulpknuckle.

name: Maple Battlestaff
description: A magical weapon carved from maple wood.

sources.notes: Maple battlestaff is a power level 6 two-handed staff that can be crafted with a mystic forge.

name: Maple Infusion
description: Made from clean water, maple sap and irit. Reduces thirst as well as stamina when blocking.

name: Maple Logs
description: Cut from maple trees. Can be crafted into various equipment.

sources.notes: Maple logs are obtained by chopping down maple trees, with a mithril logging axe  or better.

name: Maple Longbow
description: A supple longbow carved from maple wood.

sources.notes: The maple longbow is a power level 6 longbow that can be crafted from a fletching bench.

name: Maple Rod
description: A bad-ass rod, effective in Dowdun Reach.

sources.notes: The maple rod is a power level 6 Fishing tool crafted at the blacksmith's bench.

name: Maple Sap
description: Harvested from maple trees. An ingredient that can be cooked on a campfire.

sources.notes: It can be gathered from chopped maple trees.

name: Maple Shortbow
description: A limber shortbow carved from maple wood[sic]

name: Maple Syrup
description: A sweet and nutty syrup. An ingredient for various dishes.

name: Maple Toastie
description: A sweet lunch made with maple syrup and dried redberry.

name: Maple Tree Seed
description: Maple tree seeds. Plant this directly into the ground to grow your own Tree!

sources.notes: A maple tree seed is a power level 1 seed, used with the Farming skill to grow a maple tree.

name: Maple Wand
description: A finely crafted maple wand, prized for its natural affinity with magic.

sources.notes: It can be crafted at a mystic forge using 8 maple logs, 3 mithril bar, 2 glass vessel, and 8 infernal fragment.

name: Marentill Seeds
description: Marentill Seeds. Equip and use them to scatter these into a farming plot and start growing! Best Planted in Brynmoor plots.

name: Marrentil
description: A bitter tasting herb used in resistance potions.

sources.notes: Marrentil (also spelled marrentill in books) is a herb found from harvesting a marrentill plant in the Whispering Swamp and can be bought from Domri - The Merchant for 6 garou chits.

name: Master Wand
description: A wand worthy of an accomplished spellcaster. Mastery is not included.

sources.notes: It can be crafted at a mystic forge using 8 yew logs, 3 refined obsidian, 2 infinity cloth, 2 dragonstone, and 2 gypsum wax.

name: Master's Staff
description: A magical staff fashioned for a master of the mystic arts. It radiates with power.

sources.notes: Master's staff is a power level 7 two-handed staff that can be crafted at a mystic forge.

name: Meat Pizza
description: A pizza with bits of meat on it.

name: Meat Sandwich
description: A carnivore's favourite, made with flank steak and rat roast.

sources.notes: It is made with flank steak, rat roast, and bread in a cooking range after finding the recipe in the library in Dowdun Reach.

name: Meat Stew
description: Meat and vegetables, the classic combination. A warm and pleasant meal.

name: Meat Stew (decoration)
description: Be careful not to let the kebbits smell these decorations, it will drive them feral.

name: Meat Twist Sandwich
description: Meat, meat and more meat. A sandwich with flank steak, rat roast and dried redberries.

sources.notes: It is made with flank steak, rat roast, dried redberries, and bread in a cooking range after finding the recipe nearby Valerius in Dowdun Reach, between The Library and The Cathedral.

description: Collects and filters rain water into useable Clean Water over time.

name: Ram Horn
description: A large horn belonging to an animal. Used in crafting.

name: Ranged Cape
description: Congratulations! Reaching level 99 in Ranged is an astonishing feat. Wear this cape with pride.

sources.notes: The Ranged cape is a Cape of Accomplishment able to be crafted and worn at level 99 Ranged. It can be crafted at the mystic forge. Trimmed version of the cape can be crafted the same way if you have more than one skill at 99.

name: Ranger Hat
description: Ranger head gear. Wearing this gives you the urge to rob from the rich to help the poor for some reason.

sources.notes: Ranger hat is a power level 5 ranged armour that can be crafted at a armour bench.

name: Ranger Tights
description: Ranger leg gear that makes you feel both agile and slightly rebellious.

sources.notes: Ranger tights is a power level 5 ranged armour that can be crafted at a armour bench.

name: Ranger Tunic
description: Ranger armour that's as dangerous as it is dapper!

name: Rat Roast
description: A survivalist's meal. Just pretend it's something else.

name: Ravanna's Ring
description: This item loses durability over time when equipped.

sources.notes: Additional copies can be crafted from a jeweler's bench.

name: Raw Anchovies
description: Doesn't look like much now, but sear it on a bonfire and receive a delicious treat.

sources.notes: They can be gathered from net fishing spots with at least a wool net in Fractured Plains and Stormtouched Highlands.

name: Raw Armoured Catfish
description: Should be shelled before being braised.

sources.notes: It can be gathered from rod fishing spots with ideally a maple rod in Dowdun Reach at level 3 Fishing.

name: Raw Beltfish
description: You half expect it to start wriggling again.

sources.notes: It can be gathered from rod fishing spots with a yew rod in Umbral Sands at level 3 Fishing.

name: Raw Bestial Meat
description: Raw meat from beasts.

sources.notes: It is dropped by wolves and dire wolves in Fractured Plains and Stormtouched Highlands.

name: Raw Bird Meat
description: Freshly harvested from avian creatures. A staple for cooking.

sources.notes: It is dropped by chickens in Bramblemead Valley and Dowdun Reach, and terrorbirds in the Fractured Plains.

name: Raw Desert Sole
description: You half expect it to start wriggling again.

sources.notes: It can be gathered from rod fishing spots with a yew rod in Umbral Sands at level 3 Fishing.

name: Raw Farm Meat
description: Raw meat from farm animals. It can be cooked on a campfire.

sources.notes: It is dropped by cows in Temple Woods, Bramblemead Valley, and Dowdun Reach, sheep in Fractured Plains, Stormtouched Highlands, and Dowdun Reach, and rams in Stormtouched Highlands and Dowdun Reach.

name: Raw Game Meat
description: Raw meat from wild animals. It can be cooked on a campfire.

sources.notes: It is dropped by deer in Temple Woods, Bramblemead Valley, Fractured Plains, Stormtouched Highlands, and Dowdun Reach.

name: Raw Giant Krill
description: A colossal crustacean. A little soggy now, so best dry it.

sources.notes: It can be gathered from net fishing spots with at least a mystic net in Dowdun Reach.

name: Raw Herring
description: Cooked on an anvil, which may or may not be a red herring.

sources.notes: It can be gathered from rod fishing spots with ideally an oak rod in Fractured Plains at level 3 Fishing.

name: Raw Infernal Eel
description: Wriggly no more. Will need to be smoked before it goes near your palate.

sources.notes: It can be gathered from rod fishing spots with ideally a maple rod in Dowdun Reach at level 3 Fishing.

name: Raw Lobster
description: Don't worry, it's not alive anymore. Roast for best results.

sources.notes: It can be gathered from net fishing spots with at least a fine net in Fellhollow.

name: Raw Monkfish
description: Your mouth waters just looking at it.

sources.notes: Raw monkfish is a power level 7 food that can be captured at net fishing spots in the Umbral Sands region.

name: Raw Rat Meat
description: Tough, gamey meat that can be cooked and eaten.

sources.notes: It is dropped by giant rats in Temple Woods and Bramblemead Valley and vaults, rat kings in vaults, putrid rats and plague kings in the Whispering Swamp and the Bloodblight Swamp, and chinchompas in the Fractured Plains.

name: Raw Salmon
description: While it might be edible now, you'll need to fry it in this game.

sources.notes: It can be gathered from rod fishing spots with ideally an oak rod in Fractured Plains at level 3 Fishing.

name: Raw Sardine
description: A small fish that was brought into this world to be fried and eaten.

sources.notes: It can be gathered from rod fishing spots with ideally an ash rod in Temple Woods and Bramblemead Valley at level 3 Fishing.

name: Raw Shrimp
description: Schrodinger's shrimp: could end up burnt or fried.

sources.notes: They can be gathered from net fishing spots with at least a coarse net in Temple Woods and Bramblemead Valley.

name: Raw Trout
description: Grill this trout on a fire. You will thank us later.

sources.notes: It can be gathered from rod fishing spots with ideally an ash rod in Temple Woods and Bramblemead Valley at level 3 Fishing.

name: Raw Undead Bass
description: It may not look edible, but trust us: grill it and you're in for a treat.

sources.notes: It can be gathered from rod fishing spots with ideally a willow rod in Fellhollow at level 3 Fishing.

name: Raw Undead Eel
description: A dead undead eel. We suggest you braise it.

description: A tough but tasty treat.

description: Does wonders for your hunger bar. Grants the Sea Legs perk.

sources.notes: It is made by cooking raw lobster on either a campfire or a grill, and is used in fish fry.

description: The rotten farming tool is a vestige found by looting Buried Chests in Fellhollow.

description: A versatile textile used for crafting equipment and furniture. It is woven at a loom from linen thread.

sources.notes: Rough cloth is created with a loom, requiring three coarse thread.

name: Rough Cloth Bin
description: Keep your linen neatly stored away.

name: Rough Cloth Pile
description: A pile of cloth makes a home look lived in.

description: A fancy, round table.

description: A simple, round table.

description: A rare gemstone used to craft enchanted jewellery.

name: Rune Altar
description: Used for crafting Runes, the magical stones needed to cast magic.

sources.notes: Runes can be auto-crafted quickly or attuned by playing a simple minigame for more experience.

name: Rune Arrow
description: Rune arrows are prized for their exceptional flight and striking power.

sources.notes: Rune arrows are a power level 8 ammunition that are crafted at a fletching bench, and can be used to craft rune barbed arrow, poisoned rune arrow, and rune fire arrow

name: Rune Bar
description: A magically resonant metal used for crafting weapons and armour.

sources.notes: Rune bars are a processed material created with three Runite Ore and three Luminite Ore inside a blast furnace.

name: Rune Barbed Arrow
description: Lacerating arrows with tips forged from runite.

sources.notes: Rune barbed arrows are a power level 8 ammunition that can be crafted with a fletching bench.

name: Rune Bolt
description: Carefully forged rune crossbow bolts that hit hard and fly true.

sources.notes: Rune bolts are a power level 8 ammunition crafted at a fletching bench.

name: Rune Crossbow
description: A precision-engineered rune crossbow that delivers powerful, accurate shots at range.

sources.notes: A rune crossbow is a power level 8 crossbow crafted with a fletching bench.

name: Rune Crossbow Limbs
description: Expertly forged rune limbs that provide exceptional strength and durability when fitted to a crossbow.

name: Rune Dagger
description: A razor-sharp rune dagger prized for its speed, precision, and deadly effectiveness.

name: Rune Essence
description: A mysterious porous rock used as a base for powerful runes.

sources.notes: Rune essence can be gathered by mining rune essence stones surrounding the geysers around Ashenfall. Some spawn with rocks on the ground that you can easily gather from. The floating rocks require being hit (most easily with an arrow or an attack from a staff), and they will then fall to the ground to be mined.

name: Rune Fire Arrow
description: Arrows with tips forged from runite coated in fire oil.

sources.notes: Rune fire arrows are a power level 8 ammunition that can be crafted with a fletching bench.

name: Rune Greataxe
description: An imposing rune greataxe, for when a regular axe simply isn't sending a strong enough message.

sources.notes: The rune greataxe is a power level 8 two-handed melee weapon that can be crafted with a blacksmith's bench.

name: Rune Greatsword
description: A massive two-handed blade forged from runite. Few can wield such a weapon effectively, but fewer still can stand against it.

sources.notes: The rune greatswordis a power level 8 two-handed melee weapon that can be crafted with a blacksmith's bench.

name: Rune Helm
description: A sturdy rune helm built to withstand the chaos of close combat.

name: Rune Logging Axe
description: Crafted from durable runite, this axe bites deeply into timber and stands up to years of hard use.

name: Rune Mace
description: A sturdy rune mace, designed to crush armour and bone alike with devastating force.

name: Rune Pickaxe
description: A masterfully forged pickaxe of pure runite, capable of breaking through even the toughest stone with ease.

sources.notes: Rune Pickaxe is a power level 8 pickaxe that can be crafted at a blacksmith's bench. It can mine the same ores as the previous tiers, dealing 98 damage to minable ores, and 196 with a critical swing.

name: Rune Platebody
description: Thick rune plates forged into armour for the strongest of warriors.

sources.notes: Rune Platebody is a power level 8 armour piece that can be crafted on the Armour Bench. To unlock the recipe, players need to have Rune Bar crafted.

name: Rune Platelegs
description: Durable rune platelegs designed for warriors who spend more time fighting than running.

name: Rune Scimitar
description: The curved rune blade flows effortlessly from one strike to the next.

sources.notes: The rune scimitar is a power level 8 one-handed melee weapon that is crafted with a blacksmith's bench.

name: Rune Shield
description: A rune shield forged to endure punishment that would leave lesser metal in pieces.

name: Rune Spade
description: Whether digging gardening plots or unearthing treasure, this tool is built to last.

sources.notes: It is crafted at the blacksmith's bench.

name: Rune Sword
description: A finely balanced rune sword, renowned for its strength, precision, and reliability in battle.

name: Rune Warhammer
description: A colossal rune warhammer, capable of shattering shields and crushing the strongest defences.

sources.notes: The rune warhammer is a power level 8 two-handed melee weapon that can be crafted with a blacksmith's bench.

name: Rune Watering Can
description: A sturdy rune watering can, built to endure countless seasons of tending crops and gardens.

sources.notes: The rune watering can is a power level 8 watering can created at the blacksmith's bench.

name: Runecrafting Cape
description: Congratulations! Reaching level 99 in Runecrafting is an astonishing feat. Wear this cape with pride.

sources.notes: The Runecrafting cape is a Cape of Accomplishment able to be crafted and worn at level 99 Runecrafting. It can be crafted at the mystic forge. Trimmed version of the cape can be crafted the same way if you have more than one skill at 99.

name: Runite Med Helm
description: A strong rune helm, for keeping important thoughts safely inside.

sources.notes: It can be crafted at an Armour Bench using 4 Rune Bar, 4 Black Dragon Leather, 1 Vis Cloth, 1 Harmonised Compound, and 1 Draconic Vis Wax. The recipe for this item is obtained from purchasing the Deluxe Edition.

Runite ore is a basic Mining material mined from Runite Ore Nodes, which can be found all over the Scorned Wilderness region. Three ores can be smelted along 3 pieces of Luminite Ore in a blast furnace to produce Rune Bars.

name: Sacred Oil
description: Made from combining necrotic bonemeal and ectoplasm. Used as a crafting component.

name: Salve Amulet
description: The salve amulet is an amulet that can be crafted at a jeweler's bench.

sources.notes: The salve amulet is an amulet that can be crafted at a jeweler's bench.

name: Salve Crystal
description: A crystal that Doric obtained from a cave near the Salve River, back in Misthalin. Used in creating the Salve amulet.

sources.notes: Players can obtain more by buying it from Death after Seeking Salvation is completed.

name: Sandstone
description: A building material; can be ground into sand.

sources.notes: Sandstone is a basic Mining material mined from sandstone rocks, found scattered across the Fractured Plains, Stormtouched Highlands, Dowdun Reach and Umbral Sands.

name: Sapphire
description: A rare gemstone used to craft enchanted jewellery.

sources.notes: Sapphire is a gemstone that can be obtained by mining gold ore nodes. It can be found if the player has unlocked the Gem Prospector perk at level 16 Mining. It can be manually mined with an appropriate pickaxe or using the Rocksplosion spell.

name: Sapphire (decoration)
description: Sparkle sparkle.

sources.notes: The sapphire decoration does not need a foundation and can be built either indoors or outdoors.

name: Sapphire Emblem
description: One of three emblem keys required to unlock a statue.

sources.notes: This emblem is found at the north-eastern side of the Stormtouched Highlands.

name: Saradomin Cape
description: The Saradomin cape is an item that was released in the closed Alpha version of RuneScape: Dragonwilds[confirmation needed] and is currently not in the game.

name: Saradomin Symbol
description: It looks as if it is meant to sit on top of something.

sources.notes: The Saradomin symbol is an item found during the Withering Heights quest and is used to repair the Saradomin altar, which is one of the 4 altars holding up the barrier around Emberwood Village.

name: Saradominist Cloak
description: Worn by followers of Saradomin, this cloak reflects a commitment to justice and the light of reason.

name: Sauteed Sardines
description: Made by combining fried sardine and dried redberry. Grants the Warding Fish perk.[sic]

name: Sauteed Shrimp
description: A simple meal but one that will hold back the hunger.

sources.notes: It is made by cooking raw shrimp on either a campfire or a grill, and is used in shrimp omelette and weak Focused Fishing potion.

name: Sawhorse
description: Shouldn't it be a sawhornlessunicorn? A decoration for your house.

name: Sawmill
description: The Sawmill processes wood into planks!

sources.notes: The sawmill is unlocked upon obtaining a bronze bar.

name: Scarecrow
description: A wooden friend to protect your crops and keep you company in the fields.

name: Scarecrow's Key
description: A key from a scarecrow in Ghornfell.

sources.notes: A scarecrow's key is found in Ghornfell, where players will need this when scarecrow scavenging.

name: Scorch Leather
description: A light yet resilient leather, suited for survival in desert sands.

name: Scratchy Sackcloth
description: A ghostly bundle of scratchy sackcloth. It's unsettling to hold. Still, perhaps you could learn something from it.

sources.notes: It can be obtained from the buried chest at the end of X Marks the Spot.

name: Sealed Wooden Crate
description: A wooden crate, works as a cheap table for small guests.

name: Seared Anchovies
description: Hold hunger back until lunch.

name: Seared Cactus Steak
description: You'd be surprised at how tasty an eight-ounce cactus, medium-rare can be.

name: Selenic Veil
description: Perhaps you could learn from it[sic]

name: Serrated Claw
description: A vicious claw once belonging to Imaru, which was used to try and rip you apart more than a few times. Perhaps you could learn something from it.

sources.notes: Unlike the head and ascension shard, the serrated claw drops to the floor.

name: Shadow Body
description: Durable armour worn by the Children of Shadows.

sources.notes: Shadow body is a power level 6 ranged armour that can be crafted at a armour bench.

name: Shadow Chaps
description: Pliable leg armour worn by the Children of Shadows.

sources.notes: Shadow chaps is a power level 6 ranged armour that can be crafted at a armour bench.

name: Shadow Cowl
description: A ranged headpiece worn by the Children of Shadows.

sources.notes: The shadow cowl is a power level 6 armour piece that can be crafted on the armour bench.

name: Shadow Crossbow
description: A crossbow made from black metal. Similar to those used by Black Knight snipers.

sources.notes: The shadow crossbow is a power level 6 crossbow that can be crafted at a fletching bench. The recipe is unlocked after studying the sinister mechanism, which can be found in chests throughout Dowdun Reach or purchased from Postie Pete's Evil Emporium for 300 infernal fragments.

name: Shadow Sword
description: This Greatsword exists between the realm of the living and the dead.

sources.notes: The shadow sword is a power level 5 greatsword created using a blacksmith's bench. The recipe is learned by consuming the shard of smoky glass, dropped from a zogre.

name: Shadowscale Cape
description: A cape worn by those from the lands of death and decay.

sources.notes: The shadowscale cape is a stylish cape that can be created by learning the vestige from skeletal marauders and rotsworn marauders, both dropping the vestige at a 1/100 drop rate.

name: Shadowscale Hood
description: Ranger Headgear worn by the Skeleton Archer's[sic] from Fellhollow.

sources.notes: The shadowscale hood is a power level 5 ranged armour that can be crafted at a armour bench.

name: Shard of Black Pauldron
description: The remnants of a Zamorakian platebody. Perhaps you could learn something from it.

sources.notes: It is obtained through Evil Emporium for 400 infernal fragments.

name: Shard of Smoky Glass
description: The shard of smoky glass is a vestige that players can consume, receiving the recipe to create the shadow sword

name: Shard of the Dreaming Stone
description: A piece of the broken Dreaming Stone in the Dowdun Reach nexus. It whispers if you listen closely.

name: Shattered Black Blade
description: The remnants of a Zamorakian weapon. Perhaps you could learn something from it.

sources.notes: It is obtained through Evil Emporium for 300 infernal fragments. It can also be obtained through vestige chests in Dowdun Reach.

name: Shattered Black Blade (Umbral Sands)
description: Perhaps you could learn something from it.

sources.notes: It can be received as a drop by KotHaar-Kal in Umbral Sands.

name: Shelf
description: Hang on the walls to provide a nice spot for trinkets and knick-knacks.

name: Shimmerscale Powder
description: A shimmering iridescent powder. Its shifting hues are almost hypnotic.

sources.notes: Shimmerscale powder is a processed material created at a grindstone from kalphite wings, its star-like shimmer making it a key ingredient in the creation of infinity cloth.

name: Shocking Plant Bulb
description: A bitter, green herb used to make potions.

sources.notes: Shocking plant bulb is dropped by the wild lapulis vine, which is found in the Stormtouched Highlands.

name: Short 30° Thick Beam
description: Used to create a frame for structures and improve their stability.

name: Short 30° Thin Beam
description: Used to create a frame for structures and improve their stability.

name: Short 45° Thick Beam
description: Used to create a frame for structures and improve their stability.

name: Short 45° Thin Beam
description: Used to create a frame for structures and improve their stability.

name: Short 60° Thick Beam
description: Used to create a frame for structures and improve their stability.

name: Short 60° Thin Beam
description: Used to create a frame for structures and improve their stability.

name: Short Horizontal Thick Beam
description: Used to create a frame for structures and improve their stability.

sources.notes: Short horizontal thick beams may be useful for supporting short horizontal structures such as small square tiles, medium square tiles, or medium square/triangle foundations.

name: Short Horizontal Thin Beam
description: Used to create a frame for structures and improve their stability.

sources.notes: Short horizontal thin beams may be useful for supporting short horizontal structures such as small square tiles, medium square tiles, or medium square/triangle foundations.

name: Short Thin Pillar
description: A pillar that provides support.

name: Short Vertical Thick Beam
description: Used to create a frame for structures and improve their stability.

name: Short Vertical Thin Beam
description: Used to create a frame for structures and improve their stability.

name: Shrapnel
description: A collection of various sharp objects.

sources.notes: Shrapnel can be found whilst killing terrorbirds and garou hunters found within the Fractured Plains.

name: Shred of Sunbleached Weave
description: Perhaps you could learn from it

name: Shrimp Bait
description: Scraps of shrimp dressed to be eaten by fish. A Sardines favorite snack. Increases the catch chance of this fish.

sources.notes: Shrimp bait is a power level 2 Fishing bait crafted at the crafting table.

name: Shrimp Omelette
description: Made by combining fried egg and sauté shrimp. Grants the Sea Legs perk.

name: Shroud of Noggin
description: A ghostly sackcloth mask. Reduces Wither buildup while worn.

sources.notes: The shroud of Noggin is a piece of  Power level 1 head armour which can be crafted using a crafting table. The recipe is learned by consuming the scratchy sackcloth, found in a buried chest in Hope's Fall at the end of the unmarked activity X Marks the Spot.

name: Side Table
description: A tiny table.

name: Sigil of a Phoenix
description: Endlessly burning and reconstituting itself. Perhaps you could learn from it.

name: Silver Bar
description: A precious and rare metal used to craft enchanting jewellery.

sources.notes: Silver bars are primarily obtained by smelting silver ore in a furnace.

name: Silver Bar (decoration)
description: A silver bar to place around your home.

sources.notes: The silver bar decoration does not need a foundation and can be built either indoors or outdoors.

name: Silver Leaf
description: A thin sheet of finest silver, can be used for demonstrating your prowess, potion making or even recycling into silver bars.

sources.notes: To obtain these, players must either collect them from silver (or golden) reward packs or recycle silver bars in the jeweler's bench to make sheets of ten per bar.

name: Silver Medal
description: thumb|The icon for the Silver Medal in the building menu.

name: Silver Ore
description: A rare, precious ore. It can be smelted into silver bars at a furnace.

sources.notes: Silver ore is a basic Mining material mined from silver ore nodes, which are mainly found in the Bloodblight Swamp. It can be smelted at a furnace to make silver bars.

name: Silver Salvage Pile
description: Scraps that can be searched through. Take a look inside.

sources.notes: Silver salvage piles are a basic material, nine of them can be smelted in a furnace to create one silver bar.

name: Simple Rug
description: A simple rug to decorate your floor.

name: Simply Splendid Feather
description: The ancient remnants of some sort of armour. Perhaps you could learn something from it.

name: Sinister Mechanism
description: The remnants of a Zamorakian weapon. Perhaps you could learn something from it.

sources.notes: It is obtained through Evil Emporium for 300 infernal fragments. It can also be obtained through vestige chests in Dowdun Reach.

name: Skeleton Pack
description: A dusty sack that rattles when you shake it.

sources.notes: Skeleton packs are a drop from skeletons.

description: A replica skill tome to display in your home.

name: Skills Necklace
description: Provides a small chance to get extra resources when gathering them in the world.

sources.notes: The skills necklace is a trinket crafted at a jeweler's bench, and has a 1% multiplier on collecting Fishing, Mining, and Woodcutting resources.

name: Skullsplitter
description: A deadly weapon with a disturbingly accurate name.

sources.notes: Skullsplitter is a power level 3 one-handed weapon that can be crafted using a blacksmith's bench. The recipe is learned by consuming the vestige remnants of a shattered skull, received randomly as a drop from killing garou berserkers at a 1/50 drop rate.

name: Slightly Chaffing Chestguard
description: The ancient remnants of some sort of armour. Perhaps you could learn something from it.

name: Small 30° Hip Roof
description: Provides shelter to things underneath.

name: Small 30° Roof
description: Provides shelter to things underneath.

name: Small 30° Valley Roof
description: Provides shelter to things underneath.

description: Provides shelter to things underneath.

name: Small 45° Roof
description: Provides shelter to things underneath.

name: Small 45° Valley Roof
description: Provides shelter to things underneath.

name: Small 60° Roof
description: Provides shelter to things underneath.

name: Small Animal Fang
description: Sharp little teeth used in weaponry.

sources.notes: Small animal fang is a basic item dropped by kebbits, rats, and wolves.

name: Small Ash Pile
description: There seems to be something solid in the ash pile.

sources.notes: Small ash piles are a drop from hellrat and hellhound.

name: Small Blurite Bar Pile
description: A pile of blurite bars. Decoration loved by blacksmiths everywhere.

sources.notes: A small blurite bar pile is a decoration that is built with five blurite bars and does not need a foundation, and can be placed indoors or outdoors.

name: Small Blurite Bin
description: A container full of blurite. A great talking point at parties!

name: Small Blurite Nugget
description: A nugget of blurite to display in your home.

sources.notes: The small blurite nugget can be placed with or without a foundation, and can be placed either indoors or outdoors.

name: Small Bronze Bar Pile
description: A pile of bronze bars. A decoration loved by blacksmiths everywhere.

sources.notes: A small bronze bar pile is a decoration that is built with five bronze bars and does not need a foundation, and can be placed indoors or outdoors.

name: Small Clay Bin
description: Neatly stored clay. Sell this and you'll make a kiln-ing! ...sorry.

name: Small Clay Pile
description: A little bit of clay to help your day seem... er... browner?

name: Small Copper Bin
description: A container full of copper. A great talking point at parties!

name: Small Copper Nugget
description: A nugget of copper to display in your home.

sources.notes: The small copper nugget can be placed with or without a foundation, and can be placed either indoors or outdoors.

name: Small Gold Bar Pile
description: A pile of gold bars. Display your wealth for all to see!

sources.notes: A small gold bar pile is a decoration that is built with five gold bars and does not need a foundation, and can be placed indoors or outdoors.

name: Small Gold Bin
description: A container full of gold. Be the envy of dwarves everywhere!

name: Small Gold Nugget
description: Decoration

sources.notes: The small gold nugget can be placed with or without a foundation, and can be placed either indoors or outdoors.

name: Small Iron Bar Pile
description: A pile of iron bars. Blacksmiths just leave these lying around, it seems.

sources.notes: A small iron bar pile is a decoration that is built with five iron bars and does not need a foundation, and can be placed indoors or outdoors.

name: Small Iron Bin
description: A container full of iron. A great talking point at parties!

name: Small Iron Nugget
description: A nugget of iron to display in your home.

sources.notes: The small iron nugget can be placed with or without a foundation, and can be placed either indoors or outdoors.

name: Small Silver Bar Pile
description: Shining silver bars to place around your home.

sources.notes: A small silver bar pile is a decoration that is built with five silver bars and does not need a foundation, and can be placed indoors or outdoors.

name: Small Silver Bin
description: A container full of copper. A great talking point at parties!

name: Small Silver Nugget
description: A nugget of silver to display in your home.

sources.notes: The small silver nugget can be placed with or without a foundation, and can be placed either indoors or outdoors.

name: Small Square Tile
description: Sturdy surface used to create floors.

name: Small Tin Bin
description: A container full of copper. A great talking point at parties!

name: Small Tin Nugget
description: A nugget of tin to display in your home.

sources.notes: The small tin nugget can be placed with or without a foundation, and can be placed either indoors or outdoors.

name: Small Wall
description: Simple wall used to create structures.

sources.notes: A small wall is a constructed object that does not require a foundation and can be built either indoors or outdoors.

name: Small Wardstone
description: Recharges your armour with a small amount of lifeward.

name: Smithing Anvil
description: A Blacksmith's Anvil. Required for working with metals.

name: Smoked Herring
description: Nothing beats hunger like a herring. Grants the Warding Fish perk.[sic]

name: Smoked Infernal Eel
description: An unusual meal, but a good one. Grants the Warding Fish perk.[sic]

name: Smouldering Draconic Visage
description: The image of a fearsome dragon. Used in crafting powerful equipment.

sources.notes: The smouldering draconic visage is an award obtained from the Icthlarin's Little Helper quest.

name: Snapdragon
description: A sweet-smelling herb used in restorative potions.

sources.notes: Snapdragon is a herb that can be found by harvesting the Snapdragon plant in the Bloodblight Swamp or can be bought from Domri - The Merchant for 12 garou chits.

name: Snapdragon Seeds
description: Snapdragon seeds. Equip and use them to scatter these into a farming plot and start growing! Best planted in Ghornfell plots.

sources.notes: Snapdragon seeds can be obtained from harvesting wild Snapdragon.

name: Soda Ash
description: One of the ingredients for making glass, obtained from cooking Swamp Weed.

name: Sodden Black Leather
description: The remnants of a Zamorakian cowl. Perhaps you could learn something from it.

sources.notes: It is obtained through Evil Emporium for 200 infernal fragments.

name: Soft Animal Fur
description: It's so fluffy!

sources.notes: Soft animal fur is a basic item gathered from killing smaller creatures, such as wolves and dire wolves.

name: Softly Vibrating Orb
description: A sphere that seems to be playing Menu Chill. Perhaps you could learn from it.

name: Soiled Blue Cloth
description: Some dodgy-looking scraps of what seems to be a cape. Perhaps you could learn from it.

sources.notes: It is obtained through Evil Emporium for 150 infernal fragments.

name: Soiled Green Cloth
description: Some dodgy-looking scraps of what seems to be a cape. Perhaps you could lear from it.

sources.notes: It is obtained through Evil Emporium for 150 infernal fragments.

name: Soiled Pink Cloth
description: Some dodgy-looking scraps of what seems to be a cape. Perhaps you could lear from it.

sources.notes: It is obtained through Evil Emporium for 150 infernal fragments.

name: Soiled Red Cloth
description: Some dodgy-looking scraps of what seems to be a cape. Perhaps you could lear from it.

sources.notes: It is obtained through Evil Emporium for 150 infernal fragments.

name: Soiled Yellow Cloth
description: Some dodgy-looking scraps of what seems to be a cape. Perhaps you could lear from it.

sources.notes: It is obtained through Evil Emporium for 150 infernal fragments.

name: Soul Fragment
description: Someone may have use for this.

sources.notes: It is also a type of currency used in Death's Exchange to purchase several item recipes, and capes - these can be found in chests within Fellhollow, dropped by undead monsters, or mined through the soul stones found in the spectral doors.

name: Spare Farmer's Supplies
description: A cloth bag with some useful items for farmers.

sources.notes: This is given to the player after completing Growing Pains, the introductory Farming quest.

name: Spectral Book
description: Even the dead enjoy a good story. An ethereal decoration for your home.

name: Spectral Chinchompa Cape
description: Ab, artistic, if unusual, cape.

sources.notes: A spectral chinchompa skull is a quest item dropped by spectral chinchompa during the Things That Go Boom In The Night.

name: Spectral Silver Thread
description: A spooky silver thread. Used to repair mirrors from the inside.

sources.notes: Spectral silver thread is a quest item that is found after giving Edna 1 silver bar, 1 fine thread, 1 sacred oil, and 6 soul fragments, as well as the bedraggled spellbook to her during the quest, Mirror, Mirror.

name: Spinning Wheel
description: A spinning wheel can spin fibres such as flax or fleece into threads for crafting.

sources.notes: The spinning wheel is unlocked when players harvest from flax plants and receive flax for the first time.

name: Splitbark Body
description: Magical armour crafted from fine cloth and hollow bark. it has strange magical properties.

sources.notes: Splitbark body is a power level 5 magic armour that can be crafted at a armour bench.

name: Splitbark Helm
description: Magical head armour crafted from wither-corrupted hollow bark.

sources.notes: Splitbark helm is a power level 5 magic armour that can be crafted at a armour bench.

name: Splitbark Legs
description: Magical leg armour crafted from wither-corrupted hollow bark.

sources.notes: Splitbark legs is a power level 5 magic armour that can be crafted at a armour bench.

name: Splitbark Staff
description: A Mage's Weapon crafted from wither-rotted hollow bark. It has strange magical properties.

sources.notes: Splitbark staff is a power level 5 two-handed staff that can be crafted with a mystic forge.

name: Splitbark Wand
description: Crafted from enchanted splitbark, balancing resilience with arcane potential.

sources.notes: It can be crafted at a mystic forge using 6 hollow bark, 3 sacred oil, 2 fine thread, and 3 vault shard.

name: Spooky Bait
description: Bait that gives fish the heeby-jeebies, but draws them in anyway. Undead Bass love a jump scare. Increases the catch chance of this fish.

sources.notes: Spooky bait is a power level 5 Fishing bait crafted at the crafting table.

name: Square Foundation
description: Place on the ground to create the foundations for a larger structure.

sources.notes: Square foundations are constructed objects that are not required to have a roof or a stable foundation. Note that the square foundation has eight points of contact: four at the corners and four on the bottom of each vertical beam. Players can only build up to six square foundations, either stacked on top of each other or side by side, without a stable foundation in between (or at the bottom of the stack).

name: Square Tile
description: Sturdy surface used to create floors.

sources.notes: Square tile is a constructed item that is not required to have a roof and does not require a stable foundation.

name: Squeaking Sausage
description: Tail not included.

name: Stack of Bowls
description: When one bowl just isn't enough.

sources.notes: A stack of bowls is a decoration that is unlocked by learning the PLAN: stack of bowls recipe found in chests across the Fractured Plains.

name: Stacked Wooden Crates
description: Wooden crates, neatly-ish stacked together.

name: Staff of Light
description: A mystical weapon humming with power, wielded by mighty Saradominist Wizards ages past.

sources.notes: The staff of light is a power level 4 masterwork staff that can be crafted at a mystic forge. The recipe can be obtained by completing the quest Highlighting the Problem.

name: Stained Glass Window Wall
description: A stylish castle wall.

name: Stamina Potion
description: Consuming a stamina potion will prevent all loss of stamina for a short duration, however you'll need a moment to recover before you have another as such unbridled energy is taxing on the body.

name: Standing Book
description: A standing book to place in your home.

name: Standing Torch
description: A torch that can be placed on surfaces.

sources.notes: A standing torch is a constructed object that can be built either indoors or outdoors, and requires a horizontally flat foundation (e.g., another standing torch, a square tile, or on the top end of a thin or thick beam).

name: Steak
description: A delicious steak. The perfect campfire meal.

name: Steak 'N' Eggs
description: A marvelous way, to start your day.

name: Steak 'N' Eggs (decoration)
description: Leave  out a lovely plate of Steak 'N' Eggs to show off your culinary skills to your friends.

name: Steak Sandwich
description: A delectable treat made with flank steak, fried onions and grilled mushrooms.

sources.notes: It is made with flank steak, fried onions, grilled mushrooms, and bread in a cooking range after finding the recipe in The Cathedral in Dowdun Reach.

name: Steamed Beltfish
description: A long, tough meal. Don't eat it in one swallow.

name: Steel Arrow
description: Arrows with tips forged from Steel.

sources.notes: Steel arrows are a power level 5 ammunition that are crafted at a fletching bench.

name: Steel Bar
description: Made by smelting coal and iron ore together. A primary ingredient for steel weapons, armour and tools.

name: Steel Barbed Arrow
description: Lacerating arrows with barbed tips forged from Steel.

sources.notes: Steel barbed arrows are power level 5 ammunition that can be created on the fletching bench.

name: Steel Bolts
description: Crossbow bolts made from Steel.

sources.notes: Steel bolts are a power level 5 ammunition crafted at a fletching bench.

name: Steel Crossbow
description: A 1-Handed Crossbow made from Steel.

sources.notes: It is crafted at a fletching bench.

name: Steel Crossbow Limbs
description: A pair of Steel crossbow limbs. Used in crafting a Steel Crossbow.

sources.notes: They are created at a blacksmith's bench.

name: Steel Dagger
description: A fine dagger made from high-quality Steel.

sources.notes: The steel dagger is a power level 5 one-handed melee weapon that can be crafted at a blacksmith's bench.

name: Steel Fire Arrow
description: Burning arrows with tips forged from Steel coated in fire oil.

name: Steel Full Helm
description: A full helmet forged from Steel for Melee users.

sources.notes: Steel full helm is a power level 5 helmet that is crafted with a armour bench.

name: Steel Greataxe
description: A two handed Battleaxe forged from Steel.

sources.notes: The steel greataxe is a power level 5 two-handed melee weapon that can be crafted at a blacksmith's bench.

name: Steel Greatsword
description: A two handed Steel sword made famous by Highland Warriors.

sources.notes: The steel greatsword is a power level 5 two-handed melee weapon that can be crafted at a blacksmith's bench.

name: Steel Logging Axe
description: A woodcutter's tool, forged from Steel.

sources.notes: The steel logging axe is a power level 5 logging axe that can be crafted at a blacksmith's bench. Deals 40 damage when felling applicable trees, and 60 when overhead chopping to split them. The recipe and ability to craft steel logging axes are unlocked upon obtaining a steel bar for the first time.

name: Steel Mace
description: A brutal crush weapon forged from high quality Steel.

sources.notes: The steel mace is a power level 5 one-handed melee weapon that can be crafted at a blacksmith's bench.

name: Steel Med Helm
description: A dependable helm trusted by countless adventurers.

sources.notes: It can be crafted at an Armour Bench using 4 Steel Bar, 4 Draconic Leather, 1 Fine Cloth, 1 Sacred Oil, and 2 Vault Shard. The recipe for this item is obtained from purchasing the Deluxe Edition.

name: Steel Pickaxe
description: A Miner's tool, forged from steel.

sources.notes: A steel pickaxe is a power level 5 pickaxe that can be crafted at a blacksmith's bench. It can mine the same ores as the previous tiers, along with soul stone, dealing 66 damage to minable ores, and 132 with a critical swing. The recipe and ability to craft steel pickaxe are unlocked upon obtaining willow logs for the first time.

description: PERK: Focused RunecraftingGrants a 15% XP BOOST for the RUNECRAFTING Skill

name: Weak Focused Woodcutting Potion
description: PERK: Focused WoodcuttingGrants a 15% XP BOOST for the WOODCUTTING Skill

name: Weak Healing Potion
description: A potion that restores a small amount of health.

name: Weak Lumberjack Potion
description: PERK: LumberjackREDUCES the STAMINA cost of WOODCUTTING by 33%

name: Weak Quarrymaster Potion
description: PERK: QuarrymasterREDUCES the STAMINA cost of Mining by 33%

name: Weapon Barbs
description: Pointy! Used to craft Barbed Arrows or to coat your equipped melee weapon with barbs that cause Bleed buildup for a short duration.

name: Weapon Poison
description: A vial of Weapon Poison. Used in crafting Poison Arrows or to coat your equipped Melee Weapon with Poison for a short time.

sources.notes: Weapon poison is a potion that can be created at level 15 Ranged.

name: Weapon Rack
description: A rack that stores and displays weapons.

name: Weeds
description: A bunch of weeds.

sources.notes: Weeds are a Farming item, dug from Farming patches when nothing is growing on them. Players will need a spade to harvest this item, and can place it into a compost bin to convert to compost.

name: Weighted Training Band
description: You can feel it pulling away from you. Perhaps you could learn from it.

name: Well
description: Allows you to draw a limited amount of Clean Water per day. Wells refill in the morning.

name: Wheat
description: A sheaf of wheat.

sources.notes: It can be harvested from wheat (farming) after it has fully grown. Wheat seeds can be used in a farming plot to grow the source plant.

name: Wheat Seeds
description: Some Wheat Seeds. Equip and use them to scatter these into a farming plot and start growing! Best planted in Brynmoor plots.

sources.notes: Wheat seeds can be used to grow wheat in a farming plot. Wheat seeds can be obtained from goblin packs, and the Wise Old Man will give three wheat seeds to the player when starting the Growing Pains side-quest.

name: Whetstone
description: Use this to hone your equipped melee weapon.

name: Whispering Cape
description: A cloak that makes you shiver, even as it protects against the cold.

sources.notes: The recipe is unlocked by acquiring the Whispering Cape Pattern, found in a chest near the waterfall in the Whispering Swamp.

name: Whispering Elbow Pad
description: The remnants of a Zamorakian mage robe. Perhaps you could learn something from it.

sources.notes: It is obtained through Evil Emporium for 400 infernal fragments.

name: White Adventurer's Cape
description: A simple, yet stylish accessory.

name: White Desert Cape
description: A White cape, stitched in an ancient desert style. Its patterns reflect a long-standing mastery of life beneath the scorching sun.

sources.notes: The recipe is unlocked after studying the white memory of Menaphos vestige, which can be found in chests in Umbral Sands.

name: White Full Helm
description: A helmet worn by a member of the Holy Order of White Knights. It is pure white

sources.notes: White full helm is a power level 5 melee armour that can be crafted at an armour bench.

name: White Memory of Menaphos
description: Perhaps you could learn something from it.

sources.notes: The white memory of Menaphos is a vestige that unlocks the white desert cape and can be found in chests throughout Umbral Sands.

name: White Platebody
description: White Platebody worn by a member of the Holy Order of White Knights.

sources.notes: White platebody is a power level 5 melee armour that can be created at an armour bench.

name: White Platelegs
description: White Platelegs worn by a member of the Holy Order of White Knights.

sources.notes: White platelegs is a power level 5 melee armour that can be created at an armour bench.

name: Wild Anima
description: Raw magical essence, extremely useful in magical recipes and equipment. Refined by herblore masters from anima-infused bark.

name: Wild Anima (Decoration)
description: Wild anima is a constructed object decoration that is unlocked once the player has received wild anima in their inventory for the first time.

name: Wild Archer Body
description: Durable armour worn by a Wild Knight archer.

sources.notes: Wild archer body is a power level 4 ranged armour that can be crafted at an armour bench. The recipe can be obtained from Kletterbuja Kara, a dragonkin vault.

name: Wild Archer Chaps
description: Durable leg armour worn by a Wild Knight archer.

sources.notes: Wild archer chaps is a power level 4 ranged armour that can be crafted at an armour bench. The recipe can be obtained from Kletterbuja Kara, a dragonkin vault.

name: Wild Archer Cowl
description: A helmet worn by a Wild Knight archer.

sources.notes: Wild archer cowl is a power level 4 ranged armour that can be crafted at an armour bench. The recipe can be obtained from Kletterbuja Kara, a dragonkin vault.

name: Wild Pie
description: A triumph of man over nature.

name: Wild Scout's Shortbow
description: A bow used by a Wild Knight scout. Maintaining balance, one arrow at a time.

sources.notes: The wild scout's shortbow is a power level 3 shortbow that can be crafted at a fletching bench.

name: Willow Farming Plot
description: A plot made from Willow logs. Plants found in Fellhollow grow better in this plot.

sources.notes: The willow farming plot can be used to grow plants with seeds through the Farming skill. To obtain the recipe, you must interact with the crafting table after obtaining willow logs. It is the best plot to grow plants found within the region of Fellhollow.

name: Willow Logs
description: A highly efficient fuel. Required for smelting more advanced metals.

sources.notes: Willow logs are obtained by chopping down willow trees. An iron logging axe (or better) is required to chop down willow trees.

name: Willow Longbow
description: An agile Longbow crafted from Willow.

sources.notes: The willow longbow is a power level 5 longbow that can be crafted from a fletching bench.

name: Willow Rod
description: A professional-looking fishing rod, effective in Fellhollow.

sources.notes: The willow rod is a power level 5 Fishing tool crafted at the blacksmith's bench.

name: Willow Shortbow
description: An agile Shortbow crafted from Willow.

sources.notes: The willow shortbow is a power level 5 Shortbow that can be crafted at a fletching bench.

name: Willow Tree Seed
description: Willow Tree Seeds. Plant this directly into the ground to grow your own Tree!

sources.notes: A willow tree seed is a type of seed, used with the Farming skill to grow a willow tree.

name: Window
description: Windows are constructed objects which can only be placed in a wall with window frame, a wall with double window frame, or a half wall with window frame.

name: Window Box
description: Add some decoration to the outside of your windows. Or the inside, I'm not your dad.

name: Wintumber Tree
description: A decorative tree with which to celebrate the festive season.

name: Wither Water
description: A source of hydration, tainted by the realm of Imaru.

name: Withered Heart
description: Dropped from withered enemies. Used as a crafting ingredient.

sources.notes: Withered heart is a drop from rotsworn creatures in Fellhollow, and can be converted to three ectoplasms in a kiln.

name: Withering Heights Reward Pack
description: A cloth shoulder bag.

name: Wizard Hat
description: A stylish hat, popular with spellcasters.

sources.notes: Wizard hat is a power level 3 magic armour that can be crafted at an armour bench.

name: Wizard Robe Legs
description: Lightweight magical armour.

sources.notes: Wizard robe legs are a power level 3 magic armour that can be crafted at an armour bench.

name: Wizard Robes
description: Lightweight magical armour.

sources.notes: Wizard robes are a power level 3 magic armour that can be crafted at an armour bench.

name: Wizard's Kneecap
description: The remnants of Zamorakian mage robe legs. Perhaps you could learn something from it.

sources.notes: It is obtained through Evil Emporium for 300 infernal fragments.

name: Wolfbane Dagger
description: A silver dagger that brings fear to all those who howl in the night.

sources.notes: The wolfbane dagger is a power level 5 one-handed melee weapon that can be crafted at a blacksmith's bench. The recipe is acquired from a dragonkin effigy found in Vekchenven Kara, the dragonkin vault in central Fellhollow.

name: Woodcutting Cape
description: Congratulations! Reaching level 99 in Woodcutting is an astonishing feat. Wear this cape with pride.

sources.notes: The Woodcutting cape is a Cape of Accomplishment able to be crafted and worn at level 99 Woodcutting. It can be crafted at the mystic forge. Trimmed version of the cape can be crafted the same way if you have more than one skill at 99.

name: Wooden Arrow
description: A very basic arrow.

sources.notes: Wooden arrows were proposed to be power level 1 ammunition, crafted at a crafting table.

name: Wooden Barrel
description: A sturdy wooden barrel. A great decoration for your home.

sources.notes: The open wooden barrel does not need a foundation and can be placed either indoors or outdoors.

name: Wooden Barrel (storage)
description: A simple old barrel.

name: Wooden Bin
description: A small wooden crate to decorate your home.

name: Wooden Bin Pile
description: A collection of wooden crates to decorate your home.

name: Wooden Club
description: A basic melee weapon. Handy in a pinch.

name: Wooden Shield
description: Basic protection for those seeking to block and parry more efficiently.

sources.notes: The wooden shield is a power level 1 shield that can be crafted at a crafting table.

name: Wooden Spade
description: A rudimentary spade made from Ash wood.Used to clear farming plots.

sources.notes: A wooden spade is a power level 1 spade that can be crafted at a crafting table.

name: Wooden Training Sword
description: Causes damage to their self esteem more than anything really.

sources.notes: The wooden training sword is a power level 2 one-handed melee weapon that can be crafted at a crafting table. The recipe is learned by consuming the an educational blade, found in a chest atop the eastern roof of the church in Temple Woods.

name: Wooden Watering Can
description: The wooden watering can is a tool created at the crafting table.

sources.notes: The wooden watering can is a tool created at the crafting table.

name: Woodsman Ring
description: No effect

sources.notes: The woodsman ring is an unobtainable jewellery slot item found in the game files. Currently, it cannot be obtained legitimately.

name: Wool Cloth
description: A strong and lightweight crafting material.

sources.notes: Wool cloth is created in a loom using three wool thread.

name: Wool Cloth Bin
description: All your finest wool safely stored where elderly women cannot steal it.

name: Wool Cloth Pile
description: A pile of wool cloth. Earn the respect of grannies everywhere.

name: Wool Net
description: Made with two wool threads at a crafting table. Unwieldy but does the job.

sources.notes: The wool net is a power level 3 Fishing tool crafted at the crafting table. It is used to catch shrimp and anchovies from net fishing spots found in Brynmoor and Ghornfell.

name: Wool Thread
description: Spun from sheep fleece, essential for making warm garments and padded cloth.

sources.notes: It is created at a spinning wheel by using either 3 soft animal fur or 1 fleece.

name: Wool Thread Bin
description: How do you ram all this wool in there? Sorry, ewe probably think these jokes are baaaaad.

name: Wool Thread Pile
description: Are you trying to craft your own sheep?

name: Yellow Adventurer's Cape
description: A simple, yet stylish accessory.

name: Yellow Desert Cape
description: A Yellow cape, stitched in an ancient desert style. Its patterns reflect a long-standing mastery of life beneath the scorching sun.

sources.notes: The recipe is unlocked after studying the yellow memory of Menaphos vestige, which can be found in chests in Umbral Sands.

name: Yellow Dyad Cape
description: A cape made for its looks more than any kind of magical potency.

sources.notes: The yellow dyad cape is a stylish cape that can be created by learning the vestige bought from Postie Pete in Evil Emporium.

name: Yellow Hex Cape
description: A cape made for its looks more than any kind of magical potency.

sources.notes: The yellow hex cape is a stylish cape that can be created by learning the vestige bought from Postie Pete in Evil Emporium.

name: Yellow Memory of Menaphos
description: Perhaps you could learn something from it.

sources.notes: The yellow memory of Menaphos is a vestige that unlocks the yellow desert cape and can be found in chests throughout Umbral Sands.

name: Yellow Torch
description: A trusty lightsource - now in yellow.

name: Yew Farming Plot
description: How do you farm in the Umbral Sands desert-where water is scarce, the sun is deadly, and nothing can survive? The answer: a yew farming plot!

sources.notes: The yew farming plot can be used to grow plants with seeds through the Farming skill.

name: Yew Logs
description: An exceptionally durable and heat-resistant tree variety, yew is highly elastic, decay-resistant, and excellent for bending, making it a perfect choice for bows and high-quality furniture carving.

sources.notes: Yew logs are obtained by chopping down yew trees, with a adamant logging axe or better.

name: Yew Longbow
description: An impactful longbow carved from yew.

name: Yew Plank
description: A milled piece of yew timber.

name: Yew Rod
description: A fishing rod made from yew and adamant.

sources.notes: The yew rod is a power level 7 Fishing tool crafted at the blacksmith's bench.

name: Yew Shortbow
description: A strong shortbow made from yew.

name: Yew Tree Seed
description: Yew tree seeds. Plant this directly into the ground to grow your own Tree!

sources.notes: A yew tree seed is a type of seed, used with the Farming skill to grow a yew tree.

name: Zamorak Cape
description: A cape that proudly displays obeisance to the god Zamorak.

name: Zamorak Hood
description: A hood styled after the Zamorakian magi of Dowdun Reach.

sources.notes: Zamorak hood are a power level 6 magic armour that can be crafted at a armour bench.

name: Zamorak Robe Legs
description: Robe legs styled after the Zamorakian magi of Dowdun Reach.

sources.notes: Zamorak robe legs are a power level 6 magic armour that can be crafted at a armour bench.

name: Zamorak Robes
description: Zamorak Robes

sources.notes: Zamorak robes are a power level 6 magic armour that can be crafted at a armour bench.

name: Zamorak Staff
description: Standard issue for any mage in Dowdun Reach.

sources.notes: The zamorak staff is a power level 6 staff that can be crafted with a mystic forge. This staff and its recipe are unlocked after completing What's Theirs is Mine!, the nodestone quest in Dowdun Reach.
Zamorakian mage pack are a drop from mage of Zamorak and Zamorakian acolyte .

name: Zamorakian Warrior Pack
description: A sack holding the personal effects of a Zamorakian.

sources.notes: Zamorakian warrior pack are a drop from Black Knight guardians, Black Knight snipers, Black Knight warriors, elite Black Knights, Houndmaster Rexiton, or Sergeant Blister.

name: Zogre Pack
description: A foul smelling sack hewn from human skin.

sources.notes: Zogre packs are a drop from zogres.

name: Zombie Arm
description: A zombie's arm with electrifying properties. High five!

sources.notes: The zombie arm is a power level 4 melee weapon that is awarded to the player after completing The Great Body Robbery, and can then be crafted using a blacksmith's bench.

name: Zombie Axe
description: Made in the style of an ancient axe often found in the hands of zombies, it is capable of dealing both Crush and Slash damage at the same time. There seems to be more to this axe though...

sources.notes: The zombie axe is a power level 5 one-handed melee weapon that can be crafted at a blacksmith's bench.

name: Zombie Pack
description: A moist and squishy bag of bits.

sources.notes: Zombie packs are a drop from zombies and rotsworn zombies.
